THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.




With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.




THE TEAM

The mission of the Digital Technology department is to provide the technology foundations, delivery capabilities, and operational excellence that enable Digital to scale with speed and deliver exceptional digital experiences.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Aritzia is growing and our Digital Technology team is growing with it. This is a unique opportunity to join the team responsible for unlocking the value of Aritzia's data and enabling data-driven decision-making across the business. As the Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, you will transform data into actionable insights by partnering with stakeholders to understand key business questions, analyze data, and communicate meaningful recommendations. With the skills you gain in this role, the opportunities are endless – from a rewarding career in Digital Technology to continued growth and development with Aritzia.




THE ROLE

As the Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, Digital Technology, you will:

Partner and innovate with business leaders to deeply understand or identify the strategic opportunities across client acquisition, activation, retention and reactivation
Define measurement strategies to quantify the performance of various customer programs and compare their current condition against a hindsight benchmark
Support with generating actionable insights by analyzing customer behaviour through diagnostics, correlations, and hypothesis testing to grow the business and enhance customer experience
Clearly and accurately visualize and communicate data and analytics through reports, dashboards, and presentations to maximize strategic decisions




THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, Digital Technology, has:

Proven skills, education, and/or applicable certifications in:
SQL
Visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent)
Python
R or related statistical analysis and tools
Analyzing and interpreting complex datasets to generate actionable business insights
A commitment to learn, apply, champion and enrich Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles




THE COMPENSATION

At Aritzia, we provide market-leading compensation packages designed to reward impact through our pay-for-performance philosophy.




The range for roles at this level is $100,000-$300,000 per year. Total compensation may include base, bonus and/or equity depending on the role, which has the potential to be greater than this range.




With comprehensive benefits, aspirational workspaces, and elevated perks and experiences — we provide it all.




THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.
Baby Leave Program — We provide up to 16 weeks of paid time to support you and your growing family.
Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial.
Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration.
Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.
The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like snacks and refreshments, dry-cleaning, hotel, restaurant discounts, health and wellness discounts, and self-care promos.




ARITZIA




Aritzia is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to be inclusive, diverse, and representative of the communities where we work while creating an environment where every person can enjoy a successful career. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.




Requests for accommodation due to a disability or any other protected characteristic can be made at any stage of the recruitment process and during employment by contacting our People & Culture Team.

Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$118,174.00 - $177,262.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Title: Data Analyst – Class Action Defense
Description:
Description

This is an exciting opportunity to work for one of the top law firms in the U.S.! Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is looking for a Data Analyst to join our team in our Seattle, Portland, Los Angeles, or San Francisco offices.

This position offers the flexibility to be fully remote while working within reasonable commuting distance from any of our offices.

This position is responsible for supporting a dynamic and growing class-action defense practice. The data analyst will play a pivotal role in managing, analyzing, and visualizing data for complex matters, including wage and hour disputes, pay equity cases, and class-action litigation. The ideal candidate will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and demonstrate outstanding technical, analytical, and communication skills to streamline class-action litigation support processes and deliver exceptional client service.

At Davis Wright Tremaine, you will find challenging assignments, opportunities for professional growth and community involvement, and a culture of inclusion. DWT fosters inclusiveness and authenticity. Regardless of position, everyone here has a voice and the support is unparalleled.

On a Typical Day You Will

Data Management & Analytics


Partner with attorneys and clients to evaluate data needs, develop analysis strategies, and deliver clear and actionable insights.
Obtain, structure, and manage raw datasets from various sources, including payroll, timekeeping, and HRIS.
Analyze and evaluate data using advanced tools and reporting platforms to create pivot tables, charts, and intuitive visual dashboards.
Perform advanced data analytics to generate deliverables such as exposure analyses, pay equity audits, affirmative action plans, and class lists.
Design exposure analysis reports to identify key case strengths, risks, and potential settlement strategies.
Organize data workflows for wage and hour analyses, enabling efficient and accurate review across multiple data sets and record formats.



Collaboration & Communication


Work with multidisciplinary teams, including attorneys, clients, expert witnesses, and opposing counsel, to guide data-related discussions.
Collaborate with IT, eDiscovery, and Practice Support teams to ensure secure, compliant handling of sensitive data throughout the case lifecycle.
Communicate findings effectively to attorneys, clients, and other stakeholders through written reports, visual presentations, and face-to-face briefings.



Technology Strategy & Support


Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies for data analysis, visualization, and reporting for litigation support.
Leverage software such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or similar tools to deliver dynamic and interactive visualizations of crucial metrics.
Collaborate with staff in analytics roles to provide support and seamless backup coordination.



Class-Action Specific Support


Assist with analysis of potential CAFA removal.
Prepare putative class lists, perform random sampling analyses, and other tasks in support of class opposition processes.
Develop and run pay equity and EEO analyses to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and best practices.
Coordinate with expert witnesses to create polished and effective exposure models for case development and litigation defense strategy.
Generate detailed reports to support complex class-action claims, highlighting key trends and patterns in the data.



Trial & Litigation Preparation


Support attorneys during motion practice, depositions, and trial preparation with clear, accurate data summaries and visual exhibits.
Assist in reviewing data-related findings in expert reports, ensuring alignment with case objectives and litigation strategies.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Human Resources People Analytics team. In this strategic role, you will leverage your analytical expertise and problem-solving skills to transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling HR and business leaders to optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive organizational efficiency. Your work will be pivotal in shaping data-driven HR strategies and fostering organizational success. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design advanced data models and visualizations that contribute to our mission of operational excellence.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Responsibilities


Analyze HR data to deeply understand processes, trends, and opportunities, ensuring findings are actionable and aligned with organizational goals.
Design and implement advanced data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Tableau or PowerBI to drive strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with HR and business teams to identify to develop metrics that promote excellence and optimize workflows.
Perform detailed data analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of insights provided to stakeholders.
Proactively address challenges, offering innovative, data-driven solutions that enhance HR processes and outcomes.
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively, ensuring all stakeholders understand implications and actions.
Develop and maintain data documentation, run books, and data dictionaries in collaboration with HR data governance.
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in people analytics and apply them to enhance our workforce strategies.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field or equivalent in years of exp.
8+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related domains.
Expertise in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI).
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide impactful solutions.
Excellent attention to detail, ensuring recommendations are accurate and actionable.
Strong communication skills for effective interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mindset of ownership and curiosity, with the drive to understand data within its broader business context.


Preferred Qualifications


Solid experience in HR analytics, with a deep understanding of its impact on talent management and policy decisions.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Etc).
Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday and Cornerstone.
Familiarity with big data platforms and cloud technologies.


Special Mentions


Relocation assistance provided for qualified candidates.

WA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Title: Data Analyst II - Marketing Analytics
Description:
As a Data Analyst II within Marketing Analytics, you’ll perform in-depth analyses to best evaluate marketing investment and drive optimal spending decisions. You will build scalable reporting solutions that enable confident, data-driven decision-making and deliver reliable data-driven insights that contribute to marketing strategy, while working closely with predictive models and forecasting algorithms.

About The Role


Be a subject matter expert on marketing measurement.
Leverage analytical expertise and sound statistical reasoning to deliver clear, meaningful insights to complex, ambiguous questions.
Build and maintain Tableau dashboards, communicating trends and opportunities to stakeholders.
Collaborate with team members to review analyses, code, and dashboards, ensuring high-quality deliverables that answer the right questions.


About You


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field required; advanced degree a plus.
3+ years working in an analytical role in a business context is required; experience in marketing analytics is strongly desired.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including ability to write moderately complex SQL queries to build tables and views and extract data needed for analysis.
Strong proficiency in Tableau and Excel, with Python or R experience preferred as well.
Strong background in statistical analysis, with practical experience in experimental design, forecasting, and incrementality testing, and understanding of foundational statistical concepts (conditional probability, causal inference, statistical significance).
Experience reporting on and analyzing outputs from machine learning models.
Experience using AI code generation tools such as Snowflake Intelligence, Github CoPilot, and Anthropic Claude Code.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and build alignment.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical audiences in both written and verbal formats.
Strong curiosity that doesn’t stop at the “What?” but seeks to understand the “Why?” and “What if?”

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support customer’s Program Management and Business Development organization. Prior experience supporting Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Proposal Management, Sales Operations, or RFQ-to-Award processes is highly desirable.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the aerospace, manufacturing, defense, or industrial sectors, including exposure to opportunity pipeline management, win-rate analysis, forecasting, and KPI framework development.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to transform complex business data into actionable insights and leadership-ready recommendations.

Track and manage the complete RFQ-to-Award lifecycle, including RFQ receipt, quote submission, negotiations, award decisions, and program handoff.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and maintain opportunity, proposal, and award data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into pipeline health and business performance.
Analyze RFQ volumes, proposal activity, quote turnaround times, award rates, win/loss performance, and revenue opportunities.
Perform month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, and year-over-year trend analysis to identify business growth patterns and performance gaps.
Generate actionable insights on customer activity, opportunity conversion rates, business segment performance, and program trends.
Create executive-level reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint for leadership reviews.
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as RFQs received, quotes submitted, proposals pending, awards won, pipeline value, and forecasted revenue.
Conduct comparative analysis across customers, product lines, business sectors, manufacturing sites, and program portfolios.

Collaborate closely with Program Management, Estimating, Sales, Engineering, and Business Development teams to improve data quality and reporting effectiveness.

Drive continuous improvement through automation of reports, enhancement of analytics capabilities, and development of scalable business intelligence solutions.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.

Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and PowerPoint for data analysis, dashboard development, executive reporting, and business performance monitoring.
Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, and trend analysis.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, conversion drivers, business risks, and growth opportunities.

Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities


Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
2+ years of SQL experience
Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience using data to define metrics, track program health, and drive decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon experience in an analytical or program management capacity


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams

Description:
Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities


Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of program or project management experience
2+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data, track program health, and drive decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon experience in an analytical or program management capacity


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)

Description:
Ready to make a meaningful impact?

At Brighton Jones, we’re a purpose-driven, client-focused team committed to helping individuals live richer lives. As one of the largest RIAs in the nation, we’ve built a culture of continuous growth, collaboration, and community—recognized with 15 consecutive “Best Places to Work” awards including Inc.com’s 2025 list, as well as national honors for community impact.

We lead the industry in aligning wealth, passion, and purpose to help our clients thrive. With over $30 billion in assets under advisement, 300+ teammates nationwide, and a dynamic, team-based approach, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for driven, curious individuals to join our #OneTeam.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst on our team, you will build and maintain reporting assets across Power BI, Salesforce and Sigma Computing, with an emphasis on turning data into actionable insights and operational workflows. You’ll partner with internal teams - like Revenue Operations, Client Services, and Data Engineering - to deliver meaningful metrics, answer pressing business questions, and elevate our data culture.

This is an individual contributor role, reporting to the Senior Director, Data & Systems.

Take our Values in Action Self-Assessment to see how our values align!

What You'll Do:


Build Sigma-Based Analytics and Apps: Support the development of Sigma workbooks and workflow-oriented applications that help teams analyze data, act, and improve operational efficiency.
Translate Workflows into Data Solutions: Partner with business teams to understand operational processes, identify friction points, and design reporting or app-based solutions that make work easier, faster, and more consistent.
Design User-Friendly Data Experiences: Apply strong attention to detail and a user-first mindset to create clean, intuitive analytics experiences that are easy for non-technical users to understand and adopt.
Develop and Maintain Reports: Create, update, and manage dashboards and reports in both Power BI and Salesforce, ensuring operational transparency and supporting data-informed decisions across the firm.
Support Ad Hoc Analysis: Collaborate with analysts, engineers, and business partners to execute exploratory analysis and address urgent data requests with precision and clarity.
Ensure Data Integrity: QA reporting logic and outputs; proactively surface and help resolve data quality concerns in partnership with engineering and operations teams.
Document Reporting Assets: Maintain accessible documentation on key dashboards, metrics, and data sources, fostering consistency and shared understanding throughout the business.
Advance Data Fluency: Empower end users by translating report logic, metric definitions, and best-use practices into approachable guidance for everyday workflows.



What You Bring:

Title: Sr. Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. The team drives consumer adoption and expansion by analyzing market trends, optimizing acquisition strategies, and informing pricing and retention initiatives. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer growth.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
5+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
3+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
1+ years of experience leading projects


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: Senior Legal Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Overview

At MoFo, we couldn’t write our own success story without yours. Ready to write your story?

Join MoFo as a SENIOR LEGAL BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE ANALYST in our Seattle office!

https://www.mofo.com/offices

About The Role

Develop, implement, and support business intelligence, data analytics, and reporting solutions for legal matters and strategic client initiatives. Work closely with attorneys, clients, eDiscovery professionals, and other stakeholders to translate complex legal and business requirements into actionable insights and scalable analytical workflows. Serve as a subject matter resource for data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making.

Business Intelligence and Data Analytics


Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and scorecards for legal, financial, operational, and matter data.
Analyze large and complex datasets and perform ad hoc analysis in response to client, attorney, and leadership requests.
Develop and standardize key performance indicators, metrics, visual templates, and reporting conventions.
Develop self-service analytics capabilities that consolidate data, dashboards, and documentation for stakeholder use.
Replace manual, spreadsheet-based reporting with automated solutions and quantify the resulting impact.


Data Management and Technical Solutions


Develop and optimize data models, queries, integrations, and ETL/ELT processes using SQL and comparable tools.
Work with technology teams and data owners to integrate disparate systems into reliable analytical datasets.
Establish data definitions, business rules, lineage, and quality controls, and resolve data-quality issues proactively.
Follow structured development and change-management practices, including development, test, and production promotion.
Develop solutions in accordance with firm technology, security, confidentiality, and data governance requirements.


Legal and Client Analytics


Partner with attorneys and legal professionals to translate matter and client objectives into analytical requirements.
Develop analytics for matter activity, litigation and discovery metrics, financial performance, and resource utilization.
Analyze outside counsel and vendor spend to surface cost trends, budget variances, and optimization opportunities.
Develop customized reporting for strategic clients and extend successful solutions to additional matters and firm functions.
Prepare executive-ready summaries and KPI scorecards for firm and client senior leadership.


Artificial Intelligence and Innovation


Evaluate and apply emerging analytics, automation, and generative AI capabilities to appropriate use cases.
Develop AI-assisted workflows for classification, pattern identification, anomaly detection, and reporting.
Identify opportunities for responsible use of AI while maintaining appropriate human oversight and validation.


Consulting and Process Improvement


Serve as a technical and analytical consultant to attorneys, clients, eDiscovery professionals, and firm leadership.
Translate open-ended business questions into defined analytical requirements, project plans, and technical solutions.
Develop documentation, standards, and training materials for analytical tools and solutions.


About You

Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree required, preferably in business analytics, data science, computer science, economics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Four or more years of progressive experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data engineering, or legal operations analytics.
Experience designing and deploying enterprise business intelligence solutions for legal, financial, or other data-intensive functions.
Experience translating open-ended requirements from non-technical stakeholders into defined analytical solutions.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency with SQL, including window functions, common table expressions, and query optimization.
Strong experience with enterprise business intelligence platforms such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight.
Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and relational and dimensional data models, including star schema design.
Working proficiency with Python, R, or a comparable language for automation and statistical analysis.
Knowledge of data quality, governance, lineage, business rules, and analytical documentation practices.


Preferred


Advanced degree in business analytics, data science, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience with legal operations data, including outside counsel spend and matter analytics, in professional services or a similarly regulated environment.
Experience building self-service analytics platforms for large groups of non-technical stakeholders.
Experience developing AI agents, LLM-enabled automation, or prompt-engineered workflows in production.
Experience with cloud data platforms and transformation tooling such as Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, or dbt.


About Mofo

At MoFo, we collaborate as one firm, across borders, practice areas, and business functions and value fresh ideas and innovation over conformity and competition.


About Us: https://www.mofo.com/about
Inclusion + Engagement: https://www.mofo.com/community/we-at-mofo
Commitment to Pro Bono: https://www.mofo.com/community/pro-bono
The MoFo Foundation: https://www.mofo.com/culture/mofo-foundation


About Our Benefits

MoFo offers a comprehensive benefits package starting on your first day.


A variety of options for medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage to meet the needs of you and your family.
Industry-leading parental leave and family benefits including adoption and fertility treatment options and backup child and elder care.
Global wellness program, including free access to Talkspace and Calm apps.
Annual community service day to make an impact on your community and a birthday holiday just for fun.
Education reimbursement annually.
Dedicated Talent Development team.
Competitive annual profit-sharing contribution.

Additional compensation may include a discretionary bonus, overtime as applicable, health/welfare benefits, retirement contributions, paid holidays, and PTO. The range displayed is specifically for positions performed in those cities/states and may vary based on factors including but not limited to the following: local market data and ranges; an applicant's skills and prior relevant experience; and certain degrees, licensing, and certifications. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, including Fair Chance Laws and Ordinances.

Seattle salary range: $156k to $218k

For questions regarding this position, please e-mail jobs@mofo.com

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Sr Enterprise Data & Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.

You bring more than your expertise to your role, and that matters here. Your story, perspectives, and lived experiences help shape belonging at BECU and deepen how we connect with and support our employees, our members, and our communities.

PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $128,900.00-$157,500.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $99,900.00 - $186,400.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – Because People Helping People Starts With Supporting You


401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)
4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU
Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)
PTO Program + Exchange Program
Tuition Reimbursement Program
BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match


To join our dynamic team, we require candidates to be residents of WA, CA, VA, NC, OR, ID, AZ, TX, GA, or SC. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance from Tukwila, we are requesting that you come into our HQ on Tuesdays & Wednesdays.  For those candidates that live outside the commute distance of TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment. 

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

Help shape how one of the nation's largest credit unions tells its data story.

As a Sr. Enterprise Data & Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll play a key role in advancing BECU's enterprise data visualization capabilities by designing intuitive, impactful, and scalable reporting solutions that help leaders make smarter decisions. You'll partner with analytics teams, business leaders, and BI engineers across the organization to transform complex data into meaningful stories that influence strategy at every level—including executive leadership.

This role is about much more than building dashboards. You'll champion best practices in data visualization, help establish enterprise reporting standards, mentor fellow analysts, and introduce innovative ideas that elevate how BECU communicates with data. If you're passionate about the art and science of data storytelling, enjoy teaching others, and are always exploring new ways to make data more accessible and actionable, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What You’ll Do


Design intuitive, visually compelling dashboards and reporting solutions using Tableau and Power BI that enable enterprise decision-making.
Transform complex business questions into clear, meaningful data stories that drive action across Marketing, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Product, and other business functions.
Partner with business leaders, analysts, BI engineers, and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable reporting solutions that meet enterprise needs.
Champion enterprise data visualization standards, governance practices, and design principles that improve consistency, usability, and trust in reporting.
Help administer Tableau and Power BI environments, including permissions, content organization, governance, and platform best practices.
Guide analysts across the organization by mentoring on dashboard design, storytelling techniques, accessibility, and visualization best practices.
Evaluate emerging visualization trends, tools, and industry practices to continuously improve BECU's reporting capabilities and user experience.
Conduct technical demonstrations, knowledge-sharing sessions, and presentations with stakeholders ranging from analysts to executive leadership.
Collaborate with Enterprise Data Management, BI Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure high-quality, trusted, and well-governed enterprise reporting solutions.
Support data governance initiatives by promoting high-quality datasets, visualization standards, and consistent reporting practices across the organization.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

What You’ll Gain


The opportunity to shape the future of enterprise data visualization at one of the nation's largest credit unions.
The ability to influence enterprise reporting standards, dashboard design, and visualization best practices across multiple business functions.
Opportunities to mentor fellow analysts and share your expertise with a collaborative, enterprise-wide analytics community.
Exposure to executive stakeholders while helping communicate strategic business insights through impactful data storytelling.
Hands-on experience with leading business intelligence platforms including Tableau, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric.
A collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous learning, and bringing new ideas from across the data visualization community.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Mathematics, or related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 7 years of experience delivering enterprise business intelligence, reporting, and analytics solutions, including designing interactive dashboards and data visualizations using Tableau and Power BI.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into intuitive, scalable reporting and visualization solutions.
Working knowledge of SQL and experience supporting enterprise business intelligence environments, including data preparation, visualization governance, permissions, and platform administration.
Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business audiences.


Desired Qualifications


Advanced degree preferred.
Experience working within large, enterprise organizations or consulting environments supporting multiple business partners.
Experience establishing visualization standards, governance practices, or enterprise reporting best practices.
Experience participating in Tableau User Groups, Data Visualization Society, industry conferences, or other professional visualization communities.
Experience with Python, Alteryx, or other data preparation tools preferred.


JOIN THE JOURNEY

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role but fuel the growth and success of BECU? This is more than a job – it’s a chance to elevate your career, skills, and future, all while contributing to the robust operational landscape of BECU.

Embrace the opportunity to grow with us. Apply now, bring your expertise to the table, and let’s achieve excellence together at BECU. Your journey of influence, innovation, and impactful contribution starts now. #BECU #YourGrowth #BECUJourney

BECU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

Husky Health Center at the University of Washington, has an outstanding opportunity for a Business Intelligence Developer to join our team.

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the Assistant Director for Health Informatics & Data Strategy, this position will be responsible for writing and automating reports, developing dashboards, designing and administering surveys, conducting internal assessments and related activities. This position will contribute to related efforts across the UW Division of Student Life and exercise significant ownership and control over its work products and will serve as a subject matter expert and consultant to non-technical colleagues with custom data reporting requirements.

This is a 100% FTE onsite position

Salary range - $6,667 – $8,333 per month

Key Responsibilities

Report and Dashboard Development and Automation (50%)


Design, build, iterate, and automate operational and clinical reports and dashboards using Epic, Power BI, and related data sources and tools
Proactively engage with subject matter experts across a variety of units within the Husky Health Center and broader Student Life Division to understand individual needs and responsively develop solutions
Convert manual/ad hoc extracts into automated, reliable, schedule-driven, version-controlled BI assets (including parameterized and self-service reports)
Develop interactive dashboards in Power BI (or other approved platforms) that translate complex utilization, productivity, patient volume, and financial metrics into actionable views for non-technical stakeholders
Apply best practices for user interface design, readability, and accessibility
Respond to and appropriately triage requests for ad hoc reports
Write and maintain thorough technical documentation and non-technical end-user job aids for all data products
Implement automated data validation procedures and quality monitoring mechanisms


Survey & Assessment (35%)


Design and administer internal assessment surveys supporting operational and strategic goals, to inform needs assessments, evaluate experiences, and more
Apply best practices, ensure methodological rigor, data integrity, and data privacy
Build survey data ingestion and normalization workflows; integrate survey outcomes into broader BI reporting footprints
Produce presentations, summaries and reports for a variety of audiences
Perform statistical analyses to determine the significance of data outputs and identify themes, trends, or other inferential and descriptive summaries for leadership
Identify and apply key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to strategic requests for data, specifically those pertaining to student success, population health and health outcomes, and operational measures of impact within Husky Health Center and partner units in Student Life


Strategic & Stakeholder Collaboration (15%)


Meet regularly with Husky Health Center and Student Life leaders to refine requirements, prototype solutions, and align deliverables with strategic objectives
Translate business questions into measurable KPIs; recommend data-driven approaches with emphasis on high-automation, low-maintenance solutions


Other Responsibilities


Flexible and resourceful; high degree of professionalism and diplomacy; excellent people skills
Demonstrate initiative, professional judgment, and the ability to work independently and with others, with minimal on-site supervision and without structured practical training
Ability to operate in situations of uncertainty, troubleshoot challenges, and champion projects through completion
Perform other duties as assigned


Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Health Informatics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Health Information Management, Industrial Engineering; or Business Administration, Public Health, or Health Administration with quantitative/analytics focus
Two (2) years' experience designing and managing BI dashboards
Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager


Additional Qualifications


Experience designing and/or administering surveys, including experience with tools such as Qualtrics or Microsoft Forms
Ability to accomplish all primary job functions without reliance on artificial intelligence tools, including successful completion of a proctored technical assessment as part of the hiring process
Applicants will be asked to present a relevant Business Intelligence deliverable or data product from their personal portfolio or previous experience


Desirable Qualifications


Master’s degree in a listed or related field
Two (2) years of professional experience in a related field
Applied statistical analysis experience in healthcare, higher education, public health, or related fields
Experience with and knowledge of Institutional Review Board (IRB) processes
Demonstrable experience with using scripting/programming languages in task automation and/or data pipelines
Ability to effectively utilize artificial intelligence tools to enhance quality and efficiency
Experience with Epic and Workday data


Typical Working Conditions

Husky Health staff members are considered essential employees and are expected to report to work during UW closures for severe weather, natural disasters, or other emergency conditions.

Work hours: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm

Work location: Seattle Campus

Telecommute: This is a 100% onsite position. However, at the discretion of the employer, a hybrid telework arrangement may be approved for up to two remote workdays per week

About Husky Health

Husky Health Center, on the UW Seattle Campus in the Division of Student Life, is an AAAHC-accredited outpatient facility providing high quality health care to a primarily young adult population. As a student-focused clinical unit within the Division of Student Life, we are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and success of UW’s student population. We provide comprehensive, full-spectrum primary and preventive care in over 40,000 patient encounters annually. Our services include Primary and Same Day Care, Physical Therapy, Sports Medicine, OB/GYN and Travel Medicine. We are co-located with an on-site pharmacy and a branch of the UW Medicine Laboratory, and we work collaboratively with campus partners like the UW Counseling Center and Student Life’s health promotion and prevention services to provide holistic support that helps students thrive throughout their Husky experience.

Husky Health Center at the University of Washington, has an outstanding opportunity for a Business Intelligence Developer to join our team.

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the Assistant Director for Health Informatics & Data Strategy, this position will be responsible for writing and automating reports, developing dashboards, designing and administering surveys, conducting internal assessments and related activities. This position will contribute to related efforts across the UW Division of Student Life and exercise significant ownership and control over its work products and will serve as a subject matter expert and consultant to non-technical colleagues with custom data reporting requirements.

This is a 100% FTE onsite position

Salary range - $6,667 – $8,333 per month

Key Responsibilities

Report and Dashboard Development and Automation (50%)

  • Design, build, iterate, and automate operational and clinical reports and dashboards using Epic, Power BI, and related data sources and tools
  • Proactively engage with subject matter experts across a variety of units within the Husky Health Center and broader Student Life Division to understand individual needs and responsively develop solutions
  • Convert manual/ad hoc extracts into automated, reliable, schedule-driven, version-controlled BI assets (including parameterized and self-service reports)
  • Develop interactive dashboards in Power BI (or other approved platforms) that translate complex utilization, productivity, patient volume, and financial metrics into actionable views for non-technical stakeholders
  • Apply best practices for user interface design, readability, and accessibility
  • Respond to and appropriately triage requests for ad hoc reports
  • Write and maintain thorough technical documentation and non-technical end-user job aids for all data products
  • Implement automated data validation procedures and quality monitoring mechanisms

  • Apply best practices, ensure methodological rigor, data integrity, and data privacy
  • Build survey data ingestion and normalization workflows; integrate survey outcomes into broader BI reporting footprints
  • Produce presentations, summaries and reports for a variety of audiences
  • Perform statistical analyses to determine the significance of data outputs and identify themes, trends, or other inferential and descriptive summaries for leadership
  • Identify and apply key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to strategic requests for data, specifically those pertaining to student success, population health and health outcomes, and operational measures of impact within Husky Health Center and partner units in Student Life

  • Meet regularly with Husky Health Center and Student Life leaders to refine requirements, prototype solutions, and align deliverables with strategic objectives
