Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Title: SCS Business & Customer Insights Analyst II
Description:
Overview

The SCS (Sales & Customer Support) CX Insights Analyst II contributes to REI’s success by providing critical data insights, trends and analysis to enable data driven decision making, improve customer experiences across all SCS touchpoints, and support the evolution of the SCS team as we leverage technology to provide a seamless blend of expert human guidance and technology enabled solutions. The role acts a relentless advocate for our customers across their journey, identifying friction trends, quality and process improvements and utilizes voice of customer feedback/sentiment to drive action and prioritization of enterprise customer initiatives. The Analyst’s primary focus will be to complete recurring analysis, identify root causes of customer issues/pain points, and deliver concise, impactful summary of findings. Models and acts in accordance with the Co-op Way (values & mission).

Responsibilities And Qualifications

Responsibilities:


Analyze, report, and track information to identify data patterns and customer pain points using multiple data sources, including structured and unstructured customer research, benchmarks, demographics, and internal operational data.
Support SCS team share-outs with distilled insights from SCS CX Programs and listening channels to drive actionable, data-driven recommendations.
Engage in dialogue with stakeholders to understand the scope and impact of potential causes or changes to the customer experience, aiding in the interpretation of insights.
Participate in processes that drive ongoing evaluation and improvement in our listening programs, tools and dashboards (Customer intent/topic data, VOC, Quality Management).
Contribute to developing program solutions, including technical implementation of new technology platforms, systems, tools, vendor onboarding and management, integration, and ongoing data integrity maintenance of the SCS ecosystem. Requires understanding of tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Sigma, Digital Analytics - Adobe, Tealium).
Support managers with internal partner consultation, project coordination and execution, annual research, and budget planning.
Provide collaborative ad-hoc decision support and represent the voice and needs of customers among internal partners.
Monitor and evaluate accuracy and efficacy of listening tools, LLMS and sentiment analysis.
Perform regular deep dives and root cause analyses of top customer pain points.
Leverage metrics, feedback, and other data to understand the customer experience, identifying pain points and opportunities for improvement.



Qualifications:


A college degree (Bachelor’s or equivalent work experience) is required with data analytics, data science, business analytics, statistics, or marketing analytics and research focus.
5+ years of experience in similar business analytics, data science or insight roles preferably within retail/customer service.
Industry knowledge Quality, VOC, customer experience (CX), analytics, data, marketing, or other relevant experience/certifications.
High empathy to see the world through the customers eyes. Acts as an advocate for customer in the interest of building a customer-centric culture.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to explain and defend data analysis at all levels within the organization, including senior leadership. Proven ability to adapt communication style to audience (both written & verbal).
Experience completing in-depth analysis of structured & unstructured customer research data, identifying root cause of customer issues/pain points, and making recommendations on training opportunities, process improvements, and/or technology enhancements.
Technical experience in five or more of the following tools/areas of discipline: Reporting and Analytics, SQL, Sigma, Qualtrics, R/SAS, Data Consolidation, Data Visualization, Voice Analytics, Text Analytics, Report Automation, Customer Satisfaction (VOC) Metrics, Advanced Excel skills.
Ability to work independently and efficiently with a minimum of supervision. Ability to proactively manage expectations and work effectively in a collaborative, cross-divisional environment.
Proven experience using survey platforms (such as Qualtrics, business intelligence programs (such as Tableau), and statistical software (such as SPSS) to analyze data. Intermediate to advanced knowledge/use of business-related PC applications, such as Excel, Word, Outlook, and Power Point.
Actively participates and collaborates with others on one's own team and across REI for the achievement of business goals.

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst, Audience & Lifecycle
Description:
Classmates.com has spent 30 years helping people reconnect with meaningful parts of their past. The demand has endured, the data has compounded, and the opportunity now is to become much more intelligent about how we create personalized experiences for individual members, graduating classes, and communities connected by shared history.




We’re looking for a systems thinker who can work from source eventing through business decisions. You’ll help shape the data inputs, define and activate audiences, design experiments, analyze results, and work with leaders across Marketing, Product, BI/Data, and Engineering to turn evidence into better customer experiences.




This is hands-on work across large-scale consumer data and production activation systems. You’ll work directly in Snowflake and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, where the quality of the data, audience logic, experiment design, and interpretation all matter because the resulting decisions affect millions of real consumers.




Local area candidates are encouraged to apply, and please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship, visa transfer, or corp-corp arrangements.

Responsibilities
Build, validate, and operate audience segmentation and activation workflows in Salesforce Marketing Cloud across lifecycle programs.
Work directly with large-scale behavioral, lifecycle, transactional, engagement, and event data in Snowflake to identify meaningful audience patterns and opportunities.
Help shape the source eventing and data inputs needed to answer important customer and business questions, partnering closely with Product, BI, and Engineering.
Design rigorous experiments, analyze results, and use what we learn to continuously improve audience strategy, lifecycle experiences, and personalization.
Build clear reporting and communicate findings to leaders so evidence can move quickly into decisions, operational rules, and better product experiences.




Skills and Experience 
5+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience supporting production lifecycle programs, including audience segmentation and activation.
Strong experience in lifecycle marketing analytics, audience segmentation, and marketing automation operations.
Meaningful experience in consumer marketing or consumer product environments, working with individual customer behavior and lifecycle signals at scale.
Advanced SQL skills and strong hands-on Snowflake experience working directly with large customer datasets.
Strong analytical and reporting capability, including the ability to investigate ambiguous problems, validate data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly to business and technical leaders.
Hands-on experience designing and evaluating experiments, including incrementality, statistical testing, or other rigorous measurement approaches.
Curious, driven, and energized by solving ambiguous, high-impact problems with smart, collaborative people.

Scale impact

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.


Salary And Benefits


$75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr depending on experience (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Insurance:
Medical, Dental & Vision
Life & Company paid Disability
Retirement Plan (401k):
4% automatic Company contribution
Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary
Paid Time Off:
You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment
PTO increases based on years of service
Employee Choice Holidays:
32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year
Paid Holidays:
Eight (8) paid holidays per year

Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
Holidays: 13 paid days per year

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, or related fields.


Preferred qualifications:


Master's degree in relevant field.
Experience with machine learning.
Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.


About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Google Ads ecosystem. Your role is a blend of technical data analysis, strategic cross-functional leadership, and direct investigative work. You will use data to predict their next moves, influence how engineering teams build detection systems, and ensure that safety measures do not disrupt the experience for legitimate advertisers.

We are on a critical mission to protect Google's users and ensure online safety across core and emerging Ads products. Our team is at the forefront of raising the bar on content through coherent policies and scaled, effective enforcement. We have expanded beyond traditional product protections to manage emerging challenges—including brand safety and controversial content across Google's growing Ads ecosystem.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $116000 - $166000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Collaborate with cross-functional groups such as Product Manager (PM), Engineering, Sales and Legal to drive projects that increases users' safety and provide better online experience through Google Ads.
Execute complex queries and analyses, build visual models, and construct presentations on abuse trends to aid in fraud prevention and influence change in existing abuse detection systems without compromising advertiser experience.
Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce our product policies, learn scam patterns/trends and identify product vulnerabilities.
Identify automation and efficiency opportunities and drive solutions through analysis or cross-functional partnerships.
Perform on-call responsibilities on a rotating basis, including weekend coverage/holidays. This role works with sensitive content or situations and may be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting topics or content.

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Intelligence
Description:
The Sr Analyst, Workforce Intelligence serves as the analytics and insights partner to Fortive Talent Partners and OpCo HR teams. The role transforms employee listening, workforce, talent, organization, and work data into actionable insights and recommendations, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled approaches to improve the speed, scale, and quality of insight generation, enabling, better talent, workforce, and organizational decisions.

The role is responsible for Fortive's employee listening strategy and workforce intelligence capability, including the processes, methodologies, reporting, and resources that support enterprise and OpCo decision-making. Through analysis of workforce trends, employee sentiment, organizational effectiveness, skills, automation, and future workforce needs, the role helps Talent Partners, HRBPs, and leaders identify risks, evaluate options, and prioritize actions.

OPERATING MODEL

1 EMPLOYEE LISTENING & EXPERIENCE INSIGHT

2 PEOPLE & ORGANIZATION INTELLIGENCE

3 GOVERNANCE, PRODUCTS & ENABLEMENT

Own the listening strategy and convert employee feedback into potential action.

Connect people, work, organization, and technology data to illuminate decisions.

Create scalable standards, resources, and clear enterprise service commitments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE & OPERATING MODEL


Establish and continuously improve Fortive's Workforce Intelligence operating model, including services, governance, delivery standards, and stakeholder expectations.
Define and deliver a clear portfolio of workforce intelligence products, insights, resources, and support for Talent Partners and HRBPs.
Develop scalable methodologies, tools, and self-service resources that strengthen data-driven decision making across Fortive, including AI-enabled intelligence products and analytical approaches that improve insight generation, pattern detection, forecasting.
Partner with HR Technology, HR Operations, and data owners to improve data quality, usability, and reporting effectiveness.


EMPLOYEE LISTENING & ORGANIZATIONAL INSIGHT


Own Fortive's employee listening strategy, including listening priorities, survey and pulse programs, governance, reporting, and insight generation.
Partner with VP, Talent Planning & Capability as well as Talent Partners to identify critical workforce questions and translate business needs into focused listening and analytical plans.
Analyze employee sentiment, engagement, retention, organizational health, and workforce trends to identify opportunities, risks, and root causes.
Translate complex findings into practical recommendations that enable Talent Partners and HRBPs to take targeted action with business leaders.


WORKFORCE & ORGANIZATION ANALYTICS


Generate enterprise and OpCo insights across workforce, talent, skills, succession, mobility, performance, and employee experience data.
Provide Talent Partners and HRBPs with data-driven recommendations that inform talent reviews, workforce planning, succession discussions, organizational effectiveness, and capability decisions.
Apply AI-enabled and advanced analytical techniques to synthesize structured and unstructured workforce data, identify emerging patterns and risks, develop scenarios, and generate decision-relevant insights.
Analyze organization and work patterns to inform organization design, workforce productivity, automation, AI adoption, and capability planning.
Integrate multiple data sources into dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses that enable better talent, workforce, and business decisions.


SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS

OWNS

INFLUENCES

DOES NOT OWN


Enterprise employee listening strategy
Workforce Intelligence methods, standards, resources, and service commitments
Analytical quality, interpretation, validation, and responsible use of AI-enabled workforce intelligence methods
Employee experience and organizational effectiveness priorities
Workforce, organization design, automation, and capability choices
Talent, workforce planning, and action priorities
Data and technology requirements
Employee listening platforms or HR technology
OpCo talent, workforce, or organization strategy
Business staffing, organization design, or automation decisions
Enterprise HR data governance outside the role's scope
Leaders’ accountability for workforce and employee outcomes


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in industrial-organizational psychology, organizational research, analytics, data science, economics, human resources, or a related discipline preferred.
8+ years of experience in data analytics with a preference for people or workforce analytics, employee listening, organizational research, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, consulting, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience managing employee listening or survey programs preferred, as well as translating quantitative and qualitative findings into practical action.
Strong analytical capability, including statistical analysis, trend identification, data visualization, and integration of multiple forms of evidence.
Demonstrated ability to apply AI-enabled analytical tools and methods to workforce or business questions, combined with the judgment to validate outputs, recognize limitations, protect sensitive information, and ensure responsible human oversight.
Experience developing executive-level dashboards, reports, and decision-support materials that make complex topics clear and actionable.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, project management, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility with senior leaders and diverse HR partners.
Experience operating effectively in a global, matrixed environment and handling sensitive workforce and employee information with sound judgment and discretion.

Title: Clinical Data Analyst, Spotfire
Description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

The Spotfire Clinical Data Analyst will specialize in the installation, maintenance, and development of clinical data visualizations utilizing Spotfire. This role emphasizes creating and enhancing Spotfire-based patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and other customized visualization reports such as live TLFs. Additionally, the Analyst will collaborate closely with Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Science, and Clinical Operations to optimize data visualization strategies.

This position requires a full-time onsite presence at our Redmond, WA office.

Responsibilities:


Lead the installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of Spotfire for clinical data analysis and visualization
Design, develop, and maintain Spotfire dashboards for patient profiles, real-time clinical data review, surveillance, metrics tracking, and other customized visualizations
Develop sophisticated, interactive visualizations to support internal data review processes, surveillance, reconciliation, and reporting needs
Collaborate with Clinical Data Managers, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Clinical Science teams to identify requirements and translate them into effective Spotfire visualizations
Manage and continually improve the Spotfire analytics environment, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance
Establish and maintain a Global Spotfire Library, aligning visualization standards across multiple studies and programs
Train and mentor Clinical Data Managers and other stakeholders in effectively utilizing Spotfire dashboards and reports
Coordinate timelines and deliverables with Clinical Data Management and other cross-functional teams to ensure visualizations meet expectations
Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and methodologies to enhance Spotfire capabilities
Document visualization specifications, maintain clear documentation for Spotfire-related processes, and contribute to departmental SOPs
Uphold industry standards including protocol compliance, ICH GCP, FDA regulations, and CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM)


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Biostatistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Spotfire visualization development and administration in a clinical trial setting, preferably in oncology and hematology
Expert-level proficiency in Spotfire including installation, configuration, dashboard development, data integration, scripting (IronPython, TERR, etc.) and performance optimization
Strong experience developing patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and complex reports
Experience with SAS/R, SQL programming, and data manipulation
Familiarity with clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM, ADaM), experience with TLF generation preferred
Experience integrating Spotfire with clinical databases and EDC systems (e.g., Medidata RAVE, Oracle Inform, Veeva)
Strong organizational skills, critical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with regulatory guidelines including GCP, ICH, and FDA requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)


Compensation and Benefits:

Utilize SAS programming software to interpret, validate and analyze large health care data sets

Define the data process based on project scope, insight from the project lead and direction from the project's senior actuarial staff
Understand the reasons and impacts of data anomalies and exceptions on the analysis, formulate solutions, and communicate to client teams
Thrive and be motivated by an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools
Perform technical peer review for data analysis projects
Act as a mentor for junior staff


What you need to have:


BA/BS or equivalent experience required
Minimum 5 years’ experience using SAS (desired), SQL, or equivalent programming language
Experience with healthcare claims data
Strong analytical and mathematical skills
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment
Strong critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills


What makes you stand out?


Experience with Medicaid programs and associated health care data, preferably in a consulting environment
Excellent interpersonal skills; strong oral and written communication skills


Why join our team:


We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact on colleagues, clients, and communities.

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon’s culture and people who are exceptionally talented at analyzing large sets of data to build insights are critical. Your work will directly impact the decisions and strategy of the entire AWS Infrastructure Services org and our customers. You will be gathering customer needs and insights, mining large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure, building visualizations and tools for our business partners, generating insights to help senior leaders make critical business decisions. Hence, the successful BIE will not only possess the expertise and passion for analyzing data, designing metrics to measure the performance of the business, and building reporting capabilities and tools, but also will interact directly with business leaders and teams that rely on the metrics and analyses that they produce.

The successful candidate will be an expert in data analytics (data engineering and visualizations), and have exemplary verbal and written communication skills. The candidate will need to be comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail. The candidate will have to work closely with business partners to answer key business questions through the analytics their team creates. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, deep knowledge of tools and platforms (like SQL, Tableau, Redshift, Glue, Airflow) for developing business intelligence solutions as well as ability to communicate clearly, and collaborate with both business owners and other analytics teams.

Key job responsibilities


Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable solutions for ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to support analytical and business needs.
Work directly with customers to understand the business problems at hand and propose impactful analyses and solutions.
Partner with data engineers to develop automated solutions.
Develop a deep understanding of our vast data sources and identify which to use to solve specific business problems.
Manage prioritization of business intelligence requests, allocate work across the team, and be responsible for communications with our customers.
Lead the creation of user-friendly repeatable reporting solutions to minimize ad hoc customer requests.
Serve as a senior SME and lead for SQL and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
Write high quality SQL to retrieve and analyze data from relational databases (e.g., AWS Redshift).
Manage and improve our internal customer communication channels (e.g., wikis, data dictionaries).


Basic Qualifications


Experience with statistical analytics and programming languages such as R, Python, Ruby, etc.
5+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
5+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
5+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
Experience with operations/supply chain


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in statistics, data science, or an equivalent quantitative field

Title: Senior CSP Business Analyst
Description:
Overview

With a vision to "Build and sell intelligent cloud and intelligent edge solutions with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more," Global Channel Partner Sales (GCPS) is responsible for driving revenue outcomes with partners through innovative solutions–at scale! The Global Partner GTM, Programs, & Operations (GPO) organization within GCPS brings together the go-to-market strategy, programs, and platforms to accelerate growth and improve partner experience across all partner segments.

The Channel Commerce Strategy & Enablement team is looking for a highly motivated individual to lead and enable the required reporting and analytics of the Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) authorization ecosystem. This role is critical to ensure we have accurate and timely insights to evolve and transform the impact of this channel. This role works in partnership with Commercial Engineering and AI teams, operations and program compliance teams to determine preferred factors and/or data types/frameworks to include in the evaluation of business, and/or operational decisions that will provide the most relevant assessment of impact. Establishes and leverages working relationships within and across teams to ensure quality data sources, methodologies, and analytical tools and processes; driving their adoption to address business needs and deliver key insights and results. Drives the implementation of methods that create efficiency in core work related to analytics and reporting that are reusable, readily discoverable, self-service, and directed to meaningful interpretation of data that drive business decisions and impact across teams in support of the CSP authorization evolution strategy and execution, including recommending program improvements to achieve strong partner satisfaction and growth of the CSP channel contribution.

As this role will work alongside many stakeholders, it will require a balance of leadership and influence skills to support the broader strategic and insights needs of the team.

Responsibilities

Data Analysis

Leads execution of analyses, resolve analytical challenges, interpret results, address business questions with actionable insights, identify tools and reports gaps and recommend improvements to Commerce Engineering and AI teams.

Evaluation

Determines preferred factors and/or data types/frameworks , anticipate risks, synthesize across evaluation outcomes and recommend actions to meet strategic goals.

Expertise in Data

Establishes themselves as an expert in data types and sources, address gaps and quality issues with data providers, collaborate with data engineers, understands and ensures governance and security (encryption, role restrictions) of reports and insights in alignment with policies.

Improvement, Efficiency, and Innovation

Drives standardization, scalable insights, ensuring insights and reports are reusable, discoverable and self-serviceable.

AI, Automation, and Innovation

Drives the AI and automation strategy for CSP authorization analytics and reporting. Identifies, prioritizes, and implements high-value opportunities to automate manual workflows, accelerate insight generation, improve data quality, and enable proactive identification of business and program risks.

Orchestration and Collaboration

Builds strong cross-team relationships to promote quality data, methodologies, and analytical tools; encourages their use to meet business needs and provide insights. Shares expertise and proven resources to support analysis, reporting, and results interpretation.

Presentation of Results

Develops and guides others' work on presentations of analyses, including dashboards, reports, data visualizations, self-service platforms, slides, and talking points that synthesize insights into a story that influences senior stakeholders' decision making and drives business outcomes. Improve efficiency of reporting and presentations.

Understanding the Business

Link impact of internal/external trends on the business to proactively identify and address business concerns, translate stakeholders’ needs into technical requirements to develop appropriate solutions with Commerce Engineering and AI teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 6+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications


Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 6+ years’ experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience.
Strong understanding of channel partner ecosystem, preferably Cloud Solutions Providers.
Demonstrated experience applying AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or intelligent automation to solve business problems and transform operational processes.
Strong organizational, planning and analytical experience, ability to analyze and interpret business performance measures.
Strong cross-group coordination across all levels, organizational and analytical skills, the ability to work independently and take initiative to drive projects forward, the ability to deal with ambiguity and provide structure for others. 
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, an ability to work effectively under pressure and within short time constraints, resourcefulness and able to deal with ambiguity, prioritize while multi-tasking and maintain flexibility in the performance of the job responsibilities. Embracing change is essential.  
Ensures organizational readiness for business demands and meets challenging timelines in a fast-paced environment. 
Executive Relations: The ability to interact confidently with senior leaders in a highly-matrixed organization to present/defend/clarify concerns or issues regarding an existing project, program, or solution. This includes the ability to confidently address difficult questions, handle pushback from a high-level audience, and maintain an executive demeanour while engaging in challenging or sometimes high-pressure situations

Title: Anti-Fraud Analyst, TikTok Shop - USDS
Description:
Responsibilities
About the team
E-commerce's Governance and Experience is a global team responsible for ensuring our marketplace is safe and trustworthy for users, sellers, and creators. We value user satisfaction and work on policies, rules, and systems to ensure quality.

The USDS Risk Control and Security team within GNE focuses on fighting various forms of fraud and abuse within the TikTok Shop ecosystem via insight generation, scaled enforcement, automation, and prevention.

About the role
As an Anti-Fraud Analyst, you will be responsible for investigating, analyzing, and deep diving into various types of fraudulent activity within TikTok's e-commerce platform. You will use the insights that you discovered to build automated detection and enforcement rules, improve operational efficiency, and work cross-functionally to push for policy and product enhancements to close known fraud loopholes. You will also develop and track key metrics to monitor progress.

The position ensures that the business complies with US regulations and relevant laws, helps mitigate risk, and ensures adherence to company policies and procedures.

Responsibilities
- Leverage data analysis tools and query databases to conduct risk/fraud investigations. Gather and analyze data and trends to draw out key insights, document them, and then recommend policy, process, and product improvements.
- Conduct timely root cause analyses on emerging fraud trends and escalations, documenting findings to inform and initiate policy, process, and product improvements.
- Maintain our enforcement rules and policies to ensure accuracy and compliance.
- Dive into the business and dig into user behavior to identify abnormalities. Develop regulations, models and risk control strategies for policy violations based on business requirements.
- Develop key metrics to track progress and monitor fraud trends
- Create standard operating procedures as needed for scaled manual operations workflows
- Provide training and guidance to other team members on fraud detection and prevention techniques.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 2+ years of hands-on and in-depth experience in fraud and risk detection, enforcement, and investigations.
- Proficient in MySQL or other querying languages.
- Strong ability to analyze, manipulate, and identify insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
- Experience with creating rules or models to automate fraud detection or enforcement
- Demonstrated analytical thinking and problem-solving.
- Experience managing projects and coordinating with regional and cross-functional partners.
- Strong work ethic and demonstrated ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with LLM prompt engineering or LLM agent development
- Experience with Python or other scripting languages

About USDS
TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


USDS Reasonable Accommodation
USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

Title: Crime Analyst - Police
Description:
BASIC PURPOSE

Reporting directly to the Investigations Division Lieutenant this non-commissioned position supports law enforcement and public safety operations by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting crime and incident data to identify patterns, trends and emerging issues. Makes presentations on trends, prevention and/or enforcement emphasis. This role helps guide operational planning, resource allocation, investigative strategy and problem-solving efforts through timely, accurate and actionable intelligence.

Please note: The Hiring Manager reserves the right to make changes to this posting at any time.


This recruitment may be used to fill other positions of the same job classification. Once all the position(s) from the recruitment announcement are filled, the recruitment may only be used to fill additional open positions for the next six (6) months.*


First round interviews will tentatively be held the week of October 5th, 2026.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

These duties include but are not limited to the following:


Supports the Operations and Investigations Divisions, informing them of crime trend data to assist with planning the deployment of resources for preventing and suppressing criminal activities. Analyzes and focuses on crime trends involving criminal offenses and offenders, and provides strategic analysis focusing on ongoing problems with certain crimes, locations, and individuals to increase apprehension and decrease crime.
Compiles complex data and tracks and reports criminal analysis utilizing multiple means.
Extract crime analysis data from a variety of sources available to the department, including the records management system, government databases, commercial databases, daily jail booking, roster reports and open-source searches.
Develop and produce crime maps using geographic information systems (GIS) applications and conduct spatial analysis of crime data.
Collects, assembles, analyzes, and evaluates facts to draw logical conclusions and make proper recommendations.
Prepares clear, concise, and comprehensive written reports that require displaying and presenting statistical, graphical, and other reporting methods to audiences of varying technical sophistication. Develops crime summaries, profiles, statistical reports, spreadsheets, charts and other related materials to track and present findings.
Provides the analysis of collision data for traffic enforcement emphasis, and the analytical support for community policing and crime prevention programs.
Provides excellent internal and external customer service (i.e. with other jurisdictions and or the community), responding to changing customer needs and helping customers implement complete solutions.
Initiate target profile analysis, generate investigative leads and create informational reports and visualizations.
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive law enforcement information and other confidential department information.
Provide accurate, timely, and relevant analysis of crime patterns and trends to patrol and detectives that aid in the efficient deployment of department resources.
Attend department meetings, shift briefings and local/regional crime analyst and detective meetings to provide and receive information on current crime series and trends.
Share information with department personnel for increased awareness, response planning or investigative support.
Maintains current knowledge of crime analysis practices, tools, and technologies through ongoing training and professional development.


Other Duties Assigned


Performs other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor of Arts Degree in Criminal Justice, Public or Business Administration, Math, Finance, Information Technology or related field AND one (1) year experience working as a crime analyst or increasing responsible work experience.

OR

Associate’s Degree in Criminal Justice, Public or Business Administration, Math, Finance, Information Technology or related field AND two (2) years of experience working as a crime analyst or increasing responsible work experience working in criminal justice, crime prevention or related field.

OR

High School Diploma AND four (4) years experience working as a crime analyst, or increasing responsible work experience working in criminal justice, crime prevention or related field.


May have a combination of experience, education, and training that would substitute for the above requirements.


Preferred Qualifications


Completion of training and certification from a crime analyst program.
Geographic Information Systems, 28CFR Rules and Regulations, and Gang/WaGang Gatekeeper training.
Familiarity with social media accounts in a business/governmental setting.
Possession of certificates in introduction to crime analysis, advanced concepts in crime analysis, and/or criminal intelligence.


Special Requirements Or License(s)


Must pass a thorough background investigation which includes polygraph, and psychological examinations.
Must maintain a level of physical and mental fitness necessary to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without an accommodation.
Must be attentive to job safety considerations and follows all required safety policies, procedures and techniques.
Must have the ability to get certifications for access to State and Federal records systems.
Must possess a valid Washington State driver’s license at time of hire OR must obtain within thirty (30) days from date of hire, and must have a driving record acceptable to the City and the City’s insurance carrier.
Verification of identity and United States work authorization must be complete as required by the Immigration Reform and Control Act.


Knowledge Of

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES


Police Records Management Systems, GIS mapping processes, and crime prevention strategies/analysis to present detailed crime trend perspectives.
Crime trends and analysis in a business/governmental setting.
Modern quantitative research methods, research design, statistical analysis, frequency distribution, association matrices and link analysis.
FBI uniform crime reporting requirements.
Police department rank, structure, and organization, municipal ordinances, and pertinent local, state, and federal laws related to law enforcement/police department operations.
Local government, public process, community programs, and law enforcement/police department procedures.
Principles and practices of Geographic information systems (GIS).
General office procedures and practices, computers and their applications, including spreadsheets, databases, and word processing systems.
Research methods and report writing techniques; preparation and presentation of crime statistic, and narrative reports.
Telephone and e-mail techniques and etiquette.
Social media platforms, accounts and how information is shared amongst users.


Skill In:


Conducting research, analyzing crime trends, and performing statistical analysis specific to these trends.
Analyzing and organizing technical crime analysis information using critical thinking; developing appropriate metrics and providing analyses of such metrics for operational efficiencies; and preparing a variety of reports, logs, records, and files related to assigned activities.
Coordinating project work and assigned tasks, troubleshooting and solving complex technical problems, and using good judgment in decision making.
Possesses strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Planning and organizing work and meeting scheduled timelines.
Maintaining complex record keeping for correspondence, reports, and documentation.


Ability to:


Demonstrate exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to adapt delivery style, tone, and level of detail to suit frontline employees, mid-level managers, and command staff alike.
Identify crime patterns and provide actionable information for prevention and apprehension.
Perform and carry out the day-to-day responsibilities of the position by maintaining the highest ethical standards and accountability to the public.
Evaluate and recommend improvements in operations, systems, procedures, policies, and methods.
Manage several complex projects simultaneously and with extreme attention to detail, produce an accurate, thorough, and complete work product and to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Perform responsible and complex technical work using independent judgment, initiative, and discretion with specific emphasis on law enforcement/governmental operations.
Analyze complex statistics and make accurate decisions independently.
Work collaboratively on cross functional teams.
Communicate complex, sensitive, or controversial information in an effective and diplomatic manner and present a positive image of City services, both verbally and in writing.
Conduct research and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data.
Prepare accurate reports and analyses; analyze data and recommend improvements and/or solutions as appropriate.
Project a strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of the City and the Department, with the ability to foster and maintain the trust and support of employees and the community.
Enthusiastically promote the City and Department goals and priorities in compliance with all policies and procedures.
Maintain City records, assigned systems/databases, and Department information in coordination with all state and federal public records statues, retention schedules, and regulations.
Maintain confidentiality throughout all work processes.
Develop and maintain positive and cooperative relationships with internal customers, employees, public agencies, citizens, and stakeholders; compose clear and accurate correspondence to a variety of audiences.
Consistently demonstrate regular, reliable, and punctual attendance.
Operate a variety of office equipment including a personal computer.

All benefits and accruals outlined in collective bargaining agreements can be found here: Policies, Union Contracts, Pay & Benefits - City of Lacey

Investment And Retirement Programs


State retirement pension plan – Includes employer paid contributions to the State of Washington State Department of Retirement Systems (DRS)
457 Deferred Compensation (voluntary)- two options MissionSquare and DRS
Social Security benefit (for Public Employee Retirement Systems (PERS) covered staff) – Our Employee Benefits include employer paid contributions to Social Security and Employees pay the employee portion of Social Security tax.
HRA/VEBA plan- A designated monthly amount (a City and/or employee contribution) is paid into a Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) VEBA account. An HRA is a type of health plan savings account for your family’s medical care expenses and premiums, which can be accessed during employment with the City or saved and used at separation or retirement.
1% Benefit - Employer provides a 1% contribution of your monthly salary pre-tax towards two options; 1) applied to insurance premium amount owed for dependent coverage or invested into a 457 deferred compensation account; OR a cash disbursement amount applied to your check monthly but the amount is taxed.

Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Plan - employees can contribute pre-tax contributions toward IRS allowed, qualifying medical and/or daycare expenses.


Wellness Program:


The City has a robust employee Wellness program that offers a variety of resources and activities for employee well-being.


Flexible Working Arrangements:


In recognition of Commute Trip reduction efforts, the City of Lacey provides flexible and alternative work schedules for many of our workforce positions.
City Hall is within minutes driving from I-5 Exit 108, and within walking/biking distance from Park and Ride Transit Martin Way Location and the Chehalis Western Trail.


Tuition Reimbursement:


The City promotes a learning environment and encourages opportunities for employees to continue to grow in their positions and careers. The City offers tuition reimbursement (as outline in City Personnel Policies) for eligible employees.


Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF):


Employees are also eligible to apply to The Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. This program is a United States government program that was created under the College Cost Reduction and Access Act of 2007 to provide indebted professionals a way out of their federal student loan debt burden by working full-time in public service.

Title: Senior Business Operations Associate
Description:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com

Application Deadline: 10/1/2026

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Associate to help redefine how BizOps gets done at DAT. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of strategy, business intelligence, and applied AI: you'll deliver the insights leaders rely on for strategic decisions, while designing and deploying AI agents that scale and extend our analytics capabilities.

You'll partner with stakeholders across the business to surface high-value problems, develop and report on KPIs that inform target priorities and team performance, and build agentic workflows that turn recurring tasks into self-service tools. With each analysis, you'll ask the natural follow-up: what can an agent do to complement this next time?

This is a high-impact IC role with meaningful visibility at the leadership level. Agents are rapidly transforming internal BizOps functions, and you'll shape how we incorporate them into ours.

What You’ll Do

Develop and operate agentic solutions to traditional business intelligence responsibilities:


Strategic Oversight: Support leadership in developing and executing business strategies. Assist with setting organizational goals, tracking progress, and ensuring alignment across departments.
KPI development & ownership: Develop and own the key performance indicators that leadership uses to measure business health, ensuring metrics stay aligned with evolving strategic priorities.
Strategic & ad-hoc analysis: Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing to scope analytical questions, deliver deep-dive insights, and translate findings into clear recommendations that drive business decisions.
BI development & reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that make key business metrics accessible, accurate, and trustworthy across the organization.
Agent design & deployment: Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents that augment workflows, including agents that monitor metrics for anomalies, generate narrative summaries, answer ad-hoc data questions, and automate routine reporting cycles.
Performance monitoring & iteration: Track how deployed agents and dashboards perform in the wild, gather feedback from end users, and continuously refine outputs to improve accuracy, usefulness, and adoption over time.
Automation opportunity identification: Spot repetitive analytical tasks across the organization and evaluate which are best suited for agentic automation versus traditional BI tooling, balancing impact, complexity, and risk.
Data quality & integrity: Partner with Data Engineering to validate source data, surface inconsistencies, and ensure that both human-facing analyses and agent outputs are built on a trustworthy foundation.
Documentation & enablement: Document agent capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases so stakeholders know when to trust outputs and when to escalate or verify.


The Skills And Experience You’ll Bring


3-5 years in high-growth startups, strategy consulting, business intelligence, data analytics or specialized BizOps roles. Series A–C experience is a significant plus.
Strong SQL and Excel skills. You can independently get to the data you need and build the models behind your own reporting.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Daily working fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day work; comfortable writing clear prompts, evaluating outputs, debugging agent behavior, and knowing when human judgment must override automation.
Growth mindset and a willingness to work hard; this will be a high-effort, high-reward type role for those excited about building business leverage with AI.


Nice to Haves:


Experience deploying AI agents or LLM-powered tools, including thinking through evaluation, monitoring, and failure modes.
Experience in logistics, fintech, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS businesses.


Why DAT?

DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.


Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance
Parental Leave
Flexible Time Off
An additional 10 holidays of paid time off per calendar year
401k matching (immediately vested)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Short- and Long-term disability sick leave
Flexible Spending Accounts
Health Savings Accounts
Employee Assistance Program
Additional programs - Employee Referral, Internal Recognition, and Wellness
Free TriMet transit pass (Beaverton Office)
Competitive salary and benefits package
Work on impactful projects in a cutting-edge environment
Collaborative and supportive team culture
Opportunity to make a real difference in the trucking industry
Employee Resource Groups
