Title: Public Defense Research and Data Analyst
Description:
Summary

This recruitment will be used to fill a Career Service position and to create an eligibility pool to fill vacancies that may occur within the next six (6) months.

The King County Department of Public Defense (DPD) is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking individual to serve as our Public Defense Research and Data and Analyst. This position is responsible for carrying out technical support, data, and system configuration tasks of moderate complexity as directed, exercising sound judgment in day-to-day execution to prioritize assigned requests, identify appropriate solutions, and determine when issues require escalation or coordination. The position works across multiple systems and functional areas, including case management, databases, reporting, website and information management platforms, and related SaaS applications. Working under the direction of the Director of Data Analytics, and in close collaboration with the Department's eDefender Administrator as a technical thought partner, the Research and Data Analyst supports process and system improvements, assists with the implementation and testing of enhancements, and provides accurate and timely data and technical products in response to operational, policy, strategic planning, and programmatic needs. The position regularly collaborates with department staff, leadership, technical partners, and other key interested partners. The successful candidate should also be aware of significant national trends in public defense.

This recruitment may be used to fill a Career Service (CS), Term-Limited Temporary (TLT), or Special Duty Assignment (SDA) Research and Data Analyst position, and to establish an eligibility list for vacancies that may occur within the next six months. TLT and SDAs may last up to 12 months and may be extended or end early based on business needs.

The Department’s Mission Statement

The King County Department of Public Defense represents indigent adults and children facing a loss of liberty. Our department is an independent voice that advocates for their objectives, interests, and dignity.

DPD provides high quality legal representation to indigent clients in felonies, misdemeanors, juvenile defense, family defense (dependency cases), involuntary commitment (mental illness), and sex offender commitment proceedings.

DPD advocates to reduce the harm and reach of the criminal and civil legal systems that restrict our clients’ liberty, and advances policy reforms to reduce systemic racism. We strive to create a flexible workplace culture that is inclusive, respectful, and supportive, premised on a shared anti-oppression framework. To learn more about DPD, visit our website.

Job Duties

Essential job functions and duties include but are not limited to the following:


Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the department’s research, data and analytics operations and resources. Make critical decisions related to technology procurement and implementation, and coordinate the evaluation, deployment, and management of current and future technologies.
Oversee requirements, technical development, selection, testing, deployment, training, and operational support for the department’s information systems and applications.
Build and maintain strong collaboration with end users and leadership to ensure information system and application needs are met or exceeded.
Ensure research, data, and analytics operations comply with applicable laws, regulations, King County standards, and security requirements; establish and maintain effective governance structures supporting data privacy and security.
Lead the research, collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data to assess DPDs client programs and services.
In collaboration with Director’s Office leadership, help define assessment, research and evaluation priorities that support data driven decision-making and organizational improvement.
Oversee the development and maintenance of information systems, applications and data collection activities.
Lead the data and analytics team to provide high-level in-house expertise on cutting-edge public defense services.
Advance fair and equitable data practices that reduce burden, uncover inequities, and work collaboratively with department leadership to increase access to public data whenever possible.
Serve as the department’s liaison to internal and external partners on data presentations, as well as assessment and evaluation findings and approaches.
Manage multiple ongoing projects in an environment of changing priorities, time constraints, and budget limitations; identify and determine scope of work for sustainability of new and existing projects.


Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills

Public Defense Research and Data Analyst duties and essential functions may include:


Provide technical support to Department staff on software applications and case management systems, including triaging, prioritizing, and resolving support tickets submitted by non-technical staff; distinguish break/fix issues from enhancement requests, training needs, and non-system requests, and escalate as appropriate.
Ability to travel throughout King County in a timely manner.
Independently manage complex configuration, business-rule development, and system integration work within the Department’s eDefender case management system (part of the eSeries/eCourt suite), coordinating with the eDefender Administrator to align on shared system architecture and priorities.
Independently develop and troubleshoot business rules and configuration logic within eDefender, in coordination with the eDefender Administrator on shared system standards.
Independently write and troubleshoot complex SQL queries (T-SQL/PL-SQL) to support eDefender configuration, data extraction, and reporting needs.
Test configurations, updates, and enhancements within the Department's SaaS case management solution to verify functionality before deployment.
Develop and deliver in-person training sessions for Department staff on software applications, and create and maintain training documentation, user guides, and process documentation.
Manage and maintain the Department's website using Sitecore, including content updates, page maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Assist in the management, organization, and governance of documents and records within Office 365 and SharePoint, including folder structures, permissions, and version control support.
Query, clean, and standardize data from the Department's in-house case assignment and management databases to support accurate reporting and analysis.
Independently analyze complex ad-hoc data requests and deliver actionable insights directly to Department leadership to inform policy and resource decisions, often under deadline.
Support colleagues in building technical proficiency and confidence using Department data systems and software applications.
Other duties, as assigned.


Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills


Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Sociology, Anthropology, Public Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, and two or more years of relevant experience in technical support, systems configuration, or data analysis; OR any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the work.
Have working knowledge of SQL (T-SQL or PL-SQL) sufficient to write and troubleshoot queries for configuration, reporting, and data extraction purposes.
Have experience with, or the ability to learn, scripting/business-rule languages such as Groovy or Velocity, or comparable logic-based configuration languages, to support case management system customization.
Have demonstrated experience providing technical support to non-technical staff, including triaging and resolving software support requests in a professional, customer-focused manner.
Have experience with, or the ability to quickly learn, eDefender or a similar eSeries-based case management system (eCourt, eProsecutor, eSupervision), including its forms, workflow, and search configuration tools.
Are comfortable working with SaaS technology solutions and have experience testing configurations, enhancements, or integrations of low to moderate complexity.
Have experience creating training materials and delivering training to staff with varying levels of technical proficiency.
Have experience with, or the ability to quickly learn, Sitecore or similar content management systems for website administration.
Have experience optimizing and maintaining documents and information within Office 365 and SharePoint, including organizational structure and access management.
Have demonstrated experience interacting with and analyzing raw data, including cleaning and standardizing data for reporting purposes.
Can interact with a broad range of stakeholders — including staff, leadership, and external partners — to understand needs, translate them into workable solutions, and communicate technical information clearly to non-technical audiences.
Have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple, sometimes competing, priorities to produce accurate and timely work products.
Have a basic understanding of project management principles and the ability to support projects of varying size and complexity as a technical resource.
Apply a lens of equity and social justice in their work and demonstrate inclusive behaviors as a team member.
Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with individuals from diverse backgrounds and technical skill levels.


Desired Qualifications:


Demonstrated experience working in criminal justice, legal services, or public defense settings.
Demonstrated experience working in a unionized environment.


Supplemental Information

King County offers great benefits, to include a pension plan, holidays, transit pass, plus training and education opportunities to promote growth and development. Our focus is to provide our employees with work life balance.

Are you ready to make a difference? Come join the team dedicated to serving one of the nation's best places to live, work and play. This opportunity is open to all qualified applicants.

To be considered for this role submit the following items:


Completed King County application.
A current/chronological resume
Cover letter detailing your background and what you can bring to the Department of Public Defense.


This recruitment may be used to fill a Career Service, Term-Limited, or Special Duty Assignment, and to establish an eligibility list for vacancies that may occur within the next six months. Term-Limited Temporary and Special Duty Assignments may last up to 12 months and may be extended or end early based on business needs.

Note: Special Duty opportunities are only open to current King County career service employees that have completed their initial probation. Special Duty applicants must have approval from their current supervisor to accept an assignment.

Pay Upon Special Duty Placement: current employees selected for special duty will be compensated based upon the provisions of the King County Code/Personnel Guidelines for their base position.

The selection process may include evaluation of application materials and supplemental questions, interviewing, references, a personnel file review going back the last three (3) years, and if applicable a background check. You must completely fill out the application with your relevant education and work experience and attach the required documents to your application.

WORK SCHEDULE AND LOCATIONThe Data and Analytics team works in a hybrid model, with an onsite minimum of three (3) days per week. During the probationary period, employees are required to work onsite four (4) days per week. The ratio of telecommuting to onsite work will be dependent on business needs and is subject to change. The primary onsite location for this position is the Dexter Horton Building, 710 Second Avenue, Seattle.

Employees must reside in Washington state and within a reasonable distance to their King County worksite to respond to workplace reporting requirements.

Summary

This recruitment will be used to fill a Career Service position and to create an eligibility pool to fill vacancies that may occur within the next six (6) months.

The King County Department of Public Defense (DPD) is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking individual to serve as our Public Defense Research and Data and Analyst. This position is responsible for carrying out technical support, data, and system configuration tasks of moderate complexity as directed, exercising sound judgment in day-to-day execution to prioritize assigned requests, identify appropriate solutions, and determine when issues require escalation or coordination. The position works across multiple systems and functional areas, including case management, databases, reporting, website and information management platforms, and related SaaS applications. Working under the direction of the Director of Data Analytics, and in close collaboration with the Department's eDefender Administrator as a technical thought partner, the Research and Data Analyst supports process and system improvements, assists with the implementation and testing of enhancements, and provides accurate and timely data and technical products in response to operational, policy, strategic planning, and programmatic needs. The position regularly collaborates with department staff, leadership, technical partners, and other key interested partners. The successful candidate should also be aware of significant national trends in public defense.

This recruitment may be used to fill a Career Service (CS), Term-Limited Temporary (TLT), or Special Duty Assignment (SDA) Research and Data Analyst position, and to establish an eligibility list for vacancies that may occur within the next six months. TLT and SDAs may last up to 12 months and may be extended or end early based on business needs.

The Department’s Mission Statement

The King County Department of Public Defense represents indigent adults and children facing a loss of liberty. Our department is an independent voice that advocates for their objectives, interests, and dignity.

DPD provides high quality legal representation to indigent clients in felonies, misdemeanors, juvenile defense, family defense (dependency cases), involuntary commitment (mental illness), and sex offender commitment proceedings.

DPD advocates to reduce the harm and reach of the criminal and civil legal systems that restrict our clients’ liberty, and advances policy reforms to reduce systemic racism. We strive to create a flexible workplace culture that is inclusive, respectful, and supportive, premised on a shared anti-oppression framework. To learn more about DPD, visit our website.

Job Duties

Essential job functions and duties include but are not limited to the following:

  • Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the department’s research, data and analytics operations and resources. Make critical decisions related to technology procurement and implementation, and coordinate the evaluation, deployment, and management of current and future technologies.
  • Oversee requirements, technical development, selection, testing, deployment, training, and operational support for the department’s information systems and applications.
  • Build and maintain strong collaboration with end users and leadership to ensure information system and application needs are met or exceeded.
  • Ensure research, data, and analytics operations comply with applicable laws, regulations, King County standards, and security requirements; establish and maintain effective governance structures supporting data privacy and security.
  • Lead the research, collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data to assess DPDs client programs and services.
  • In collaboration with Director’s Office leadership, help define assessment, research and evaluation priorities that support data driven decision-making and organizational improvement.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of information systems, applications and data collection activities.
  • Lead the data and analytics team to provide high-level in-house expertise on cutting-edge public defense services.
  • Advance fair and equitable data practices that reduce burden, uncover inequities, and work collaboratively with department leadership to increase access to public data whenever possible.
  • Serve as the department’s liaison to internal and external partners on data presentations, as well as assessment and evaluation findings and approaches.
  • Manage multiple ongoing projects in an environment of changing priorities, time constraints, and budget limitations; identify and determine scope of work for sustainability of new and existing projects.

Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills

Public Defense Research and Data Analyst duties and essential functions may include:

  • Provide technical support to Department staff on software applications and case management systems, including triaging, prioritizing, and resolving support tickets submitted by non-technical staff; distinguish break/fix issues from enhancement requests, training needs, and non-system requests, and escalate as appropriate.
  • Ability to travel throughout King County in a timely manner.
  • Independently manage complex configuration, business-rule development, and system integration work within the Department’s eDefender case management system (part of the eSeries/eCourt suite), coordinating with the eDefender Administrator to align on shared system architecture and priorities.
  • Independently develop and troubleshoot business rules and configuration logic within eDefender, in coordination with the eDefender Administrator on shared system standards.
  • Independently write and troubleshoot complex SQL queries (T-SQL/PL-SQL) to support eDefender configuration, data extraction, and reporting needs.
  • Test configurations, updates, and enhancements within the Department's SaaS case management solution to verify functionality before deployment.
  • Develop and deliver in-person training sessions for Department staff on software applications, and create and maintain training documentation, user guides, and process documentation.
  • Manage and maintain the Department's website using Sitecore, including content updates, page maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Assist in the management, organization, and governance of documents and records within Office 365 and SharePoint, including folder structures, permissions, and version control support.
  • Query, clean, and standardize data from the Department's in-house case assignment and management databases to support accurate reporting and analysis.
  • Independently analyze complex ad-hoc data requests and deliver actionable insights directly to Department leadership to inform policy and resource decisions, often under deadline.
  • Support colleagues in building technical proficiency and confidence using Department data systems and software applications.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Sociology, Anthropology, Public Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, and two or more years of relevant experience in technical support, systems configuration, or data analysis; OR any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the work.
  • Have working knowledge of SQL (T-SQL or PL-SQL) sufficient to write and troubleshoot queries for configuration, reporting, and data extraction purposes.
  • Have experience with, or the ability to learn, scripting/business-rule languages such as Groovy or Velocity, or comparable logic-based configuration languages, to support case management system customization.
  • Have demonstrated experience providing technical support to non-technical staff, including triaging and resolving software support requests in a professional, customer-focused manner.
  • Have experience with, or the ability to quickly learn, eDefender or a similar eSeries-based case management system (eCourt, eProsecutor, eSupervision), including its forms, workflow, and search configuration tools.
  • Are comfortable working with SaaS technology solutions and have experience testing configurations, enhancements, or integrations of low to moderate complexity.
  • Have experience creating training materials and delivering training to staff with varying levels of technical proficiency.
  • Have experience with, or the ability to quickly learn, Sitecore or similar content management systems for website administration.
  • Have experience optimizing and maintaining documents and information within Office 365 and SharePoint, including organizational structure and access management.
  • Have demonstrated experience interacting with and analyzing raw data, including cleaning and standardizing data for reporting purposes.
  • Can interact with a broad range of stakeholders — including staff, leadership, and external partners — to understand needs, translate them into workable solutions, and communicate technical information clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple, sometimes competing, priorities to produce accurate and timely work products.
  • Have a basic understanding of project management principles and the ability to support projects of varying size and complexity as a technical resource.
  • Apply a lens of equity and social justice in their work and demonstrate inclusive behaviors as a team member.
  • Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with individuals from diverse backgrounds and technical skill levels.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience working in criminal justice, legal services, or public defense settings.
  • Demonstrated experience working in a unionized environment.

Job Description

The Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder will be a member of the S&OP/S&OE technical enablement team supporting NCoder, Nordstrom's network volume planning product within Supply Chain Network Throughput Planning. NCoder transforms cross-functional enterprise plans and forecasts into warehouse-level volume plans across six connected Anaplan models — Inbound, DC Outbound, Store Inbound, Returns, and Task, staged through a central DataHub — informing operational resource decisions across Nordstrom's distribution centers, fulfillment centers, and stores. The Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder will own the design, build, and maintenance of NCoder's Anaplan models, partnering closely with Supply Chain planners and engineering to keep the platform scalable, well-governed, and aligned to evolving business needs.

A day in the life…


Design, build, and maintain modules, dashboards, and calculation logic across NCoder's Anaplan models (Inbound, DC Outbound, Store Inbound, Returns, Task)
Partner with Supply Chain planners and product/engineering leads to translate volume-planning requirements into scalable Anaplan model designs
Manage and troubleshoot data connections between Anaplan and DataHub, the central staging layer that receives all external data from BigQuery via Airflow import DAGs
Maintain the model sequence and dependencies across Workstream 1 (Inbound → DC Outbound → Store Inbound) and Workstream 2 (Returns, running independently), both feeding the downstream Task model
Optimize models for performance and usability as planning cadence, data volume, and new workflows (e.g., fulfillment, last mile) come online
Document model logic, data flows, and business rules to support governance, onboarding, and audit needs
Partner with data engineering on BigQuery source/destination tables and Airflow DAG issues that affect model refreshes
Train and support Supply Chain planners and downstream consumers (Warehouse Ops, Transportation, Store Ops, SC Finance) on using NCoder models
Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop to accelerate model documentation, testing, and workflow automation


You own this if you have…


Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
3-5+ years building and maintaining Anaplan models; Anaplan Certified Model Builder (Level 3) or equivalent preferred
Strong understanding of Anaplan architecture: modules, lists, hierarchies, actions, dashboards, hub-and-spoke model design
Experience with data integration/ETL — BigQuery, Airflow-orchestrated pipelines, or similar
Comfortable with SQL for querying source and destination tables
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into structured technical model designs
Supply chain domain experience preferred (DC/FC/store operations, inbound/outbound logistics, returns, or labor/task planning)
Comfortable presenting to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Title: Sales Strategy & Data Analytics: GTM Decision Intelligence Quantitative Analyst - US Remote
Description:
Req ID: 388969

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

NTT DATA North America is seeking a GTM Decision Intelligence Quantitative Analyst to develop, test, explain, operationalize, and improve evidence-based go-to-market recommendations for sales leaders and sellers. The Analyst combines bookings, market data, account plans, partner targets and offerings, internal solutions, sales plays, industry points of view, and historical outcomes using quantitative methods and approved AI capabilities. The role converts fragmented information into prioritized account-partner-solution opportunities and next-best-motion recommendations without replacing seller judgment or Solution & Strategy content ownership.

This role will work remotely from your home office located within the US.

Responsibilities Include:

Analytical Design and Data Fusion


Frame ambiguous commercial questions as testable analytical problems, data requirements, features, hypotheses, acceptance criteria, and experiments.
Combine structured and unstructured internal and external data into governed, analysis-ready features with documented lineage and limitations.
Design account-solution-partner-fit, whitespace, propensity, relevance, timing, and next-best-motion methods.
Use approved AI capabilities for synthesis, classification, comparison, research acceleration, and analytical workflow orchestration while preserving human review and source traceability.


Recommendation Engine and Validation


Develop and maintain recommendation scoring logic, confidence thresholds, prompts, transformations, business rules, versions, and controlled release criteria.
Test recommendations against known outcomes, holdout samples, business rules, edge cases, stakeholder challenge, and observed field outcomes.
Assess coverage, missing data, skew, instability, drift, unintended bias, false precision, and model risk; escalate material concerns before use.
Create explainable recommendation outputs that communicate supporting evidence, confidence, assumptions, limitations, and suggested seller action.


Cross-Tower Collaboration and Learning


Partner with Solution & Strategy for governed solution, sales-play, offering, and industry-content inputs.
Partner with the Sales Tower for seller context, business validation, recommendation release, field activation, and feedback.
Capture recommendation disposition, seller feedback, opportunity progression, and observed outcomes to improve methods without overstating causality.
Operationalize repeatable analytical workflows with KPI Reporting, Analytics Shared Services, Data and AI teams, and responsible-AI stakeholders.


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s or advanced degree in statistics, economics, operations research, data science, computer science, engineering, applied mathematics, business analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience translating business questions into quantitative analysis, scoring methods, experiments, or recommendation systems.
Proficiency with SQL, Python or comparable analytical tools, plus strong Excel and business-intelligence skills.
Experience using AI-assisted analytical workflows with source traceability, validation, human review, and responsible-AI controls.
Strong knowledge of feature design, validation, explainability, data quality, bias and drift considerations, and analytical documentation.
Ability to build broad knowledge across partner ecosystems, industries, solutions, sales motions, market signals, account planning, and commercial performance.
Strong communication skills and ability to influence senior sales, strategy, data, and business stakeholders without owning final commercial decisions.


Systems and Tools

SQL, Python or comparable analytical language, Approved AI platforms, Power BI, Excel, Model / code repository, Salesforce and approved data environments.

Role Success Indicators


Recommendation precision and useful coverage
Validation and explainability quality
Seller adoption and feedback capture
Stable, documented methods
Improvement from observed outcomes
Responsible-AI compliance and reusable analytical assets


Key Working Relationships

Works with Sales leaders and sellers, the Sales Tower, Solution & Strategy, Data and AI stakeholders, KPI Reporting, Analytics Shared Services, Finance and Sales Operations, and Partner Execution leadership.

Role Scope Clarification

This role requires generalist knowledge across strategic partners and the ability to learn partner-specific programs, terminology, systems, and processes. This role is not dedicated to a single partnership.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have an immediate need for a Sr. Data Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon and/or Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Data Analyst will support the newly formed Assistant Secretary of War for International Armaments Cooperation. Provide a dedicated data analytics capability in converting large volumes of data from disparate sources into decision-quality products. Manage data extraction, cleansing, and normalization from Department of War data platforms and other validated sources to support analysis and visualization for senior government leaders. Sources include Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT), Foreign Military Sales Single Tracking System (STS), International Agreements Tracking System (IATS), and Advana. Assist with streamlining ASW IAC workflows via PowerBI and PowerAutomate tools.

Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing automated data pipelines, processing complex government datasets, and building business intelligence dashboards
Expert proficiency with PowerBI, PowerAutomate, and Sharepoint systems
Active Secret clearance
Able to work fully onsite based on client needs


Desired


Active TS/SCI clearance
5+ years of experience


Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0247289

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Enterprise Intelligence (EI) team is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join D&I to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Loopback Health is hiring an innovative and team-oriented Data Analyst within the Health System Solutions team to work on a blend of clinical, economic and operational datasets to answer questions across the healthcare delivery and life sciences value chain.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

Duties to Include


Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs


Travel


Expected to be minimal.


This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Loopback

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Our work sits at the intersection of data, technology, and patient care, and we’re building a purpose-driven team that reflects that mission.

Founded in 2009, Loopback has been recognized by the Dallas Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work, reflecting a culture grounded in collaboration, trust, and impact. Loopback has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and consistently ranks among the fastest-growing companies in Dallas by the Dallas Business Journal.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:

À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

  • Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».

La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.

  • Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.

  • Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.

  • Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.

Exigences

  • D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
  • 2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
  • Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
  • Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
  • Bilinguisme français et anglais.
  • Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.

About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.


What We Offer

  • ** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
  • 100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
  • Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
  • Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
  • Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
  • A MacBook computer on your first day.
  • 3 weeks vacation.
  • 5 personal days to use at your discretion.
  • A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
  • The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
  • A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.


About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
  • Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
  • Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
  • Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
  • Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
  • Special projects, and other duties as required.


Candidate Qualifications

  • Strong problem solving skills.
  • 2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
  • Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
  • Understanding of statistical principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fully bilingual in English and French.
  • Ability to coordinate across teams.


Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Corporate Overview



Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems; you will be expected to communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Responsibilities

Develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions
Develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making
Leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment
Dive into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth
You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems
Communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Requirements

3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills including abnormality detection, predictive analysis, market segmentation, and competitive analysis.
Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required
Experience in R or Python is required
Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required
Experience with automation in an enterprise setting is a major place

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About JLG, An Oshkosh Company

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

As a member of the Data Analyst team, your primary responsibilities will be to identify, collect, process, and analyze datasets to help make informed business decisions. You will also assist with data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents.

YOUR IMPACT


Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from internal data sources to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests for projects which are function/business unit specific
Under limited supervision, responsible for data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents, including resolution of root causes.
Apply skills in SQL and statistical techniques to the acquisition, enrichment, and analysis of data.
Resolve incidents, changes, problems, tasks, and demands
Applies knowledge of process, people, product, data, and systems of related business functions within at least one business unit
Define Business Problems & Opportunities
Define Relevant Dimensions & Measures
Collaborating with Data Engineers, draft and test data views to meet business needs for projects
Collaborating with Data Scientists, learn and align on basic understanding of predictive and prescriptive analytics, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence
Provide Data to Confirm Problems & Opportunities
Draft Goals, Roles, and Sustainment Plans
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, data engineers, business operations support, consultants) on data needs for solutions which may be projects focused on a single business function within a single business unit (Limited Complexity)
Apply technical writing and verbal communication skills to assist in the change management (e.g. training instructions) and on-going management of data solutions.
Actively participate in Function/Business Unit/Digital Technology Analytics Communities of Practice
Assist business' citizen analysts in building views and in analyzing, interpreting, and communicating data insights.



Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.
Three (3) or more years of experience in Data Analysis, Information Technology, or in a related area.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to travel 20%



Standout Qualifications


Experience in data analysis, analytics
Attention to detail, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
Analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Experience and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and/or C#



WORKING CONDITIONS

The following represents general working conditions for this office-based role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances.


This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment with standard lighting, ventilation, and temperature-controlled settings.
Duties are largely sedentary, requiring extended periods of sitting and using a computer and telephone.
Visual acuity to operate a computer and read documents is required, along with auditory ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings.
Occasional movement within the office environment is necessary, including walking short distances, standing, or reaching for files.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.



Pay Range

$73,200.00 - $117,800.00

The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success.
