Title: Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

SeekWell is the parent company of 1-800 Contacts, Luna, and The Framery. Our goal is to make it simpler, easier, and more accessible for people to get the vision care they need. We maintain the legendary, award-winning culture 1-800 Contacts started almost 30 years ago and continue to develop innovative, pioneering products and businesses that make consumers cheer. We’re owned by KKR – one of the world’s largest and most successful private equity investment companies. We’ve built an excellent company and changed an industry by putting the customer first, always. The best is yet to come!

Why you want this job

In this role, you’ll work closely with SeekWell’s operations teams to turn data into insights that help the business make smarter decisions and improve how we work. You’ll collaborate with teams across the organization, dig into data, and have the opportunity to see your work make a real impact. If you’re a go-getter who enjoys solving problems with data, this is a great opportunity to grow your skills and build your career with a collaborative team.

What You’ll Do


Collect, clean, and transform data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency in analysis, maintaining all necessary data dictionaries. 
Support enterprise data migration projects by analyzing data requirements, translating current operational logic into new platforms, and refactoring processes to maintain data integrity.
Build and maintain Databricks Silver tables designed to serve analytics and reporting needs, ensuring data quality and consistency throughout data migrations.
Work closely with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to clearly articulate the data needs for analysis and actively participate in the collaborative data modeling process. 
Continuously monitor data quality and provide recommendations for improvement and contribute to the development and maintenance of data infrastructure and tools. 
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. 
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and visualizations to present data-driven insights. 
Clearly communicate findings to stakeholders through reports, presentations, and informal communication channels like Slack. 


What You'll Need


4+ years of data analyst experience in a corporate setting
Proficiency with Databricks and SQL
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely
Hybrid Work Requirement: Ability to work in the office two days per week in Draper, UT


Why we will love you


Experience with data analysis tools such Python, R, and Excel
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
Experience with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities
Comfortable interacting with stakeholders from all levels of the organization
Familiarity with data management best practices and regulatory requirements for sensitive data (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA)


Perks


Free eye exams for your entire family
Deep discounts on lenses, glasses, and other services
Amazing healthcare coverage
401(k) match
Flexible PTO
Tuition reimbursement program
In-house restaurant with highly discounted meals (Steak dinner under $6)
Free snacks, ice cream, and drinks every day
Full onsite gym

Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst - Visualization Specialist

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: None

Type of Travel: None

* * *

The Opportunity

CACI is searching for a Data Analyst - Visualization Specialist to join a worldwide engineering, operations, and tech refresh contract supporting Enterprise IT (EIT) capabilities and functions for our Intelligence Community (IC) customer.

As a team, we will be responsible for operations, future technologies, engineering and Tier 2/3 support, break/fix, and tech refresh activities to develop and maintain agency wide capabilities on a global basis.

Be a part of something greater than yourself and make a lasting impact at CACI.

This position is contingent upon contract award

Responsibilities


Responsible for the overall Tech Refresh data analysis & visualization performed under this contract.
Responsible for providing system data, and process improvement recommendations for means of automation for Tech Refresh operations and data management.
Provides project data, updates, and standings to cover future DIA, Defense Intelligence Enterprise growth for sites to come that fall within scope of Tech Refresh while preparing data requirements for Tech Refresh utilization of schedule, project success, implementation, and executions of assets.
Performing analysis to assess quality and meaning of data
Using statistical tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends in complex data sets
Assigning numerical value to essential business functions so that business performance can be assessed and compared over periods of time.
Analyzing local, national, and global trends that impact both the organization and the industry
Preparing reports for the management stating trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
Working with programmers, engineers, and management heads to identify process improvement opportunities, propose system modifications, and devise data governance strategies. 
Preparing final analysis reports for the stakeholders to understand the data-analysis steps, enabling them to take important decisions based on various facts and trends. 
Seasoned technical contributor
Works independently with limited supervision
May manage projects / processes
Influences others regarding system design, solutions, and procedures


Qualifications

Required:


Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) with ability to obtain a polygraph.
Minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as data science, statistics, mathematics, or computer science.
Demonstrated experience in collecting, acquiring, extracting, integrating, inspecting, cleaning, and modeling data.
Bachelor's Degree plus 7 years of experience (or equivalent) and a minimum of 5 years in data analysis experience.
Possess knowledge and experience with data analysis and data technical expertise in data management, engineering, and science.
The Data Analyst must have excellent communication, teamwork, leadership and conflict management, and critical thinking skills.
Experience with Dashboards, visualizations


What You Can Expect

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$90,300-$189,600

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Mission

To create an organization that sets the standard of excellence in the compassionate treatment of behavioral health and addiction disorders.

Who are we?

Since 2015, Nevada Behavioral Health Systems (NBH) has been providing mental health and substance abuse services to residents across Nevada. By collaborating with a diverse network of experienced behavioral healthcare providers, we have built a community-based care system that offers members personalized options tailored to their individual needs. In 2023, we rebranded as NovumHealth with the expansion of our services in Arizona, California, and Utah.

Position: Data Analyst

Location: Las Vegas, NV – Onsite (This role is not eligible for Remote or Hybrid)

Starting Salary Range: $60,000 - $70,000

The starting salary range for this role is a reasonable estimate, with a goal to pay a competitive market salary focusing near the median of our pay ranges. However, final offers for all positions will be based on several factors such as experience level, education and certification, skills, and internal pay equity.

What’s the role?

The Data Analyst is responsible for leveraging data to uncover actionable insights that drive clinical, operational, and business decisions. This role requires expertise in healthcare analytics, specifically in interpreting clinical and operational data requests, managing large claims datasets, and developing data visualizations that effectively tell a story to diverse stakeholders. Proficiency with healthcare frameworks such as HEDIS, NCQA, and value-based care metrics is critical to success in this role.

What you’ll do:


Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to translate requests into actionable queries and analytics that inform decisionmaking.
Analyze large datasets, including claims data, to uncover trends, identify risks, and generate insights related to cost, utilization, and quality.
Develop dashboards and visualizations in Power BI to present findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences, tailoring presentations to executive stakeholders when necessary.
Design and implement frameworks for tracking healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care measures.
Perform data cleaning and validation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of datasets.
Create comprehensive reports that combine storytelling with quantitative insights to drive actionable recommendations.
Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement or cost optimization through data analysis.
Support ad hoc requests for data analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of results.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including clinicians, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment of data analytics with organizational goals.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in healthcare analytics.


What you’ll bring:


Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and statistical modeling.
Familiarity with electronic medical records systems.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI for developing dashboards and visualizations.
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases and preparing datasets for analysis.
Experience with data cleaning and working with large, complex datasets.
Indepth understanding of healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care frameworks.
Exceptional storytelling skills to present data in a meaningful way to diverse stakeholders.
Strong critical thinking and problemsolving abilities to uncover insights and recommend solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex data findings to nontechnical audiences.


What you’ll need to start:


Bachelor’s degree Analytics, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Health Informatics, Public Health or a related field Preferred.
3+ years of experience with healthcare analytics, with a strong focus on clinical and operational data.
Proven experience with claims data analysis, including familiarity with total cost of care and utilization metrics.
Certified Healthcare Data Analyst (CHDA) certification or similar credentials.
Must pass drug screening and background check in order to start employment with NovumHealth.


What will make you stand out:


Experience in Power BI, SQL, R, and other complex data analysis.


What do we offer?


Competitive Salary
Generous vacation policy, paid holidays, and paid sick time
Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, and Vision Insurance (Employeepaid)
Optional supplemental Insurance Coverage
Company paid access to Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
401k Retirement Savings Plan
Free Financial coaching and access to Credit Lines and Personal Loans through FinFit
Preferred Auto, Home and Renter’s insurance through Allstate
Employee Discounts through Corestream
…and so much more!


Please note: This list is not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Offerings may vary based on subsidiary entity or geographic location

Additional information:


At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location on a fulltime basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities in the world. With thousands of locations across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords.



We've been recognized as A Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having Best Career Growth, ranked us in the Top 5% for Work Culture, and in the Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion.



We're a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange.



Public Storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. We are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence.





Job Description



Position Summary



The Data Analyst will be a key member of the Revenue Management team, responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that support strategic pricing decisions. The Analyst will use their analytical skills to gather, validate, and implement pricing strategies based on performance data. In addition will provide managerial reporting and trends for revenue performance. The position works closely with our team of internal analysts, external business partners, and our information technology group. The primary goal is to help us improve the revenue generating effectiveness of our consumer by translating complex and massive data sets into actionable insights and recommendations for senior management.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct in-depth analysis of large datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and variances
Apply data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights
Build and maintain data models that reflect complex business processes and relationships
Create clear, comprehensive reports and presentations for stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver customized insights
Ensure data quality, integrity, and security by following governance standards and best practices
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and presentation abilities.
Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
Ability to work efficiently under pressure, accurately meet deadlines, present a professional demeanor and work well independently is essential


Qualifications







Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field
2+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role or graduate in above fields from top universities.
Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
Highly proficient in Excel and comfortable with using formulas, vlookups and pivot table and graph
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is helpful but not required
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively

Preferred Skills:



Master’s degree in a relevant field

Workplace



One of our values pillars is to work as One Team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.
Use of Git and use of project management systems such as Jira.
Good grasp of basic statistical concepts.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with AI, such as the use of AI-code generation, is a positive.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting are preferred




Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 depending on office location

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.




Organizational Overview

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world-class service to approximately 1.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast-paced and fast-changing--each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation.




It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Realtor.com is a two-sided platform helping match the consumers on our site and apps to our paying customers. The Data Science & Analytics team at Realtor.com provides trusted data and insights to optimize every aspect of consumer/customer experience and to drive the company’s commercial performance.

Avail Realtor.com is a fast-growing platform transforming how independent landlords and tenants manage the rental experience. Built with the spirit of a startup and backed by the scale and stability of a leading digital real estate company, Avail provides a complete suite of tools, resources, and education to help landlords manage their properties with confidence and professionalism. As part of the Avail team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact – shaping the future of this rapidly expanding brand and helping to reimagine the rental industry for millions across the U.S..

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst with a strong background in business intelligence and strategic analytics to help shape the future of Avail. As a trusted partner to the Avail leadership team, you will be the vital link between complex data and pivotal business moves, striving to enable and empower data-driven decision making across the business.

In this role, you will analyze large and complex data sets, define and track business KPIs, build automated reporting solutions, conduct robust analyses, generate actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations that inform critical decisions across strategy, product, marketing, and operations.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented analytics expert, a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, and a team player who excels in cross-functional collaborations, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and driven by a desire to make things better.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with Avail business stakeholders to understand/clarify needs and requirements, and translate them into analytical problems.
If the required data is not available, work with the team to identify the right data sources, and build analytical data layers in collaboration with the data engineering partner.
Independently conduct end-to-end data analytical work from data collection, ETL, analysis, to the delivery of insights and recommendations.
Serve as Avail’s Business Intelligence expert and own KPI development, measurement, tracking, and reporting. Closely monitor KPIs and carry out deep-dive analysis to explain changes and trends, and surface areas of opportunities.
Own and run regular business performance reporting, and actively contribute analytics-related content to business reviews and other reports.
Build automated reports and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Mixpanel, etc.
Build and grow adoption of self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access data and insights, and hence accelerate data-driven decision making.
Conduct market and competitor analysis using a variety of internal and external data sources.
Work with Avail leadership team on strategic initiatives and planning, providing analytical support on financial modeling, forecast, opportunity sizing, and so on.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree, ideally in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
6+ years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
SQL proficiency is a must, with 6+ years of experience.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for quick reporting and ad hoc analysis.
Strong capability to work with complex data sets and perform EDA, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Snowflake and AWS.
Significant experience creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar tools.
Proven experience using data and analytics to drive revenue and other business KPIs, and doing so in a proactive manner by actively seeking to identify opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse technical and business audiences at different levels.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners.
Experience managing multiple priorities, responding to urgent data requests, and adapting to changing business needs and priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Experience in the tech sector, especially marketplace or property tech.


How We Work

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:


Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off
8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location


Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise Services
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)


Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics is a data subject matter expert enhancing decision making, monitoring business performance, providing actionable insight, and driving operational efficiencies using advanced analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will model, analyze, and predict complex business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will oversee and support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements; collect, integrate, clean, model, and analyze large datasets; and visualize and present insights to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Use Azure Databricks and advanced SQL to transform and model data, and Power BI to deliver governed, insight‑driven reporting and analytics solutions

Ability to write complex and efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate and transform data from multiple sources and automate data pipelines
Advanced skills in Power BI, Data Modeling, Power Query, and DAX

Strong experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling
Polished communication and presentation skills to audiences including senior leadership

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Compensation Range: $175K - $210K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As the Senior Data Analyst, you specialize in collecting, organizing and analyzing data from various sources with the purpose of turning numbers into context and recommendations. You paint a picture of how the business is operating using a variety of data analysis techniques and statistics. You integrate, transform and improve volumes of data at the project or company level for streamlined processes, greater efficiencies and more informed decision-making. As a Senior Data Analyst, you must demonstrate leadership among peers and extremely deep knowledge of your industry and business.

About The Role


Proactively identify and communicate business opportunities and recommendations using data manipulation, programming, statistics and data visualization
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with executive leadership or other stakeholders
Lead design and validation for all phases of research projects, including presentation of results, guiding iterative improvement
Maintain relationships and alignment among stakeholders to meet objectives
Define, gather, and validate project data requirements and evaluate data quality
Evaluate the quality of organizational data sources
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports or methods
Document technical design standards for reporting solutions to ensure their accurate development
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions
Identify and analyze relevant, external data to monitor the competitive environment
Stay informed of industry or business trends that pertain to data
Mentor teammates on any of the above responsibilities


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology or a related field
4 years of experience or equivalent competency identifying business problems, conducting data experiments, performing statistical analysis and synthesizing findings to guide business decisions
Experience leading end-to-end data analysis projects resulting in positive business changes
Expertise creating data visualizations using modern business intelligence (BI) tools, highlighting insights as relevant
Proficiency with industry-standard statistical analysis tools, such as SAS, R or Python
Experience training and mentoring peers
Experience creating data sets with advanced SQL or other querying languages and using them to develop business strategies
Experience researching data lineage
Advanced practical knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Experience working with data warehouses
Experience data mining or using other exploratory techniques
Experience working with structured and unstructured data
Experience writing software functions to support data analysis
Experience contributing to standards and processes that increase efficiency and impact
Conceptual knowledge of logical and physical data models
Domain knowledge of multiple business areas


Preferred Qualifications


Comprehensive knowledge of at least one business area and its data, including industry or other external sources
Experience in several business areas and familiarity with associated data
Conceptual knowledge of big data, machine learning, or data science


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

Rocket is a Detroit-based company made up of businesses that provide simple, fast and trusted digital solutions for complex transactions. The name comes from our flagship business, now known as Rocket Mortgage®, which was founded in 1985. Title: Data Analytics
Description:
Job Description

Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a Data Analyst to work on our Business Management team. Our team works a 9/80 schedule located out of our Idaho Falls EROB facility with every other Friday off. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer for Business Management.

The Data Analyst performs complex data analysis to support business operations including statistical modeling and analysis of structured and unstructured datasets to develop metrics, reports and visualizations of trends and patterns. The Data Analyst creates and maintains statistical models for ongoing and ad hoc review and analysis of data. This position uses data visualization programs, tools, and techniques to generate dashboards, reports and presentations that aid in data storytelling, understanding and interpretation of trends and patterns.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities


Perform statistical modeling and analysis of structured and unstructured datasets to develop metrics, reports and visualizations of trends and patterns.
Work with business end-users to understand current and future data and analysis needs and develop technical requirements.
Partner with development and data management roles to identify and capture data required from internal and external sources.
Create and maintain statistical models for ongoing and ad hoc review and analysis of data.
Use data visualization programs, tools, and techniques to generate dashboards, reports and presentations that aid in data storytelling, understanding and interpretation of trends and patterns of business importance.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities


Skills include data analysis techniques (e.g., A/B testing, association rule learning, cluster analysis, pattern recognition and predictive modeling), data analysis and visualization software (e.g., Domo, PowerBI, Tableau).
Ability to understand data structures.
Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement
solutions.
Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or
approaches to problems.
Ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.
Ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events).


Minimum Requirements


Level 2-Bachelor’s Degree and 2 years of experience in related field in Data Science or closely related field or a Master’s Degree in Data Science or related field
Level 3: Bachelor’s Degree and 5 years of experience in related field in Data Science or closely related field or a Master’s Degree and 2 years of experience in Data Science or related field
Experience in data science, data analysis, and visualization software using Power BI.


Preferred Experience


Experience with cloud services and cloud-based analytics is a plus (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.)
Experience with TeamMate+ for risk assessment, issue tracking and reporting.
Experience with Python, Natural Language Processing Techniques, Graph Databases, Relational Databases and a general understanding of data storage and processing.


Job Information

Level 2-Grade 430 ($66,504 - $136,356); Level 3-Grade 440 ($79,344 - $162,732.) At Idaho National Laboratory compensation decisions are determined using factors such as education, relevant experience, and other credentials.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, use hands to handle materials, manipulate tools, keyboard, and type, reach with hands and arms, and operate job-related equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with people is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

About Us

Benefits and Relocation


Medical, Dental, Vision, and Flexible Spending Accounts

Permanent Full Time

As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner


What You Will Bring


Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life
1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset


Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, London, Winnipeg. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

26WD99647, Senior Data Analyst

Position Overview 

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join the Strategic Data & Research team in our Go-To-Market Data Intelligence team. The GDI team is chartered with delivering accurate foundational data and customer intelligence to inform go-to-market (GTM) teams’ engagement across the customer lifecycle.

Data Analysts play a critical role in shaping GTM focus areas by uncovering insights, influencing business decisions, and partnering across functions to deliver customer intelligence used throughout the customer lifecycle.

We are open to remote candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities 


Own analytics projects from problem definition through delivery, identifying opportunities to refine the scope as new insights emerge
Drive investigative analyses, using business context and data to determine the next questions worth answering rather than simply executing predefined requests
Collaborate with Program Managers to explore new project ideas or enhancements 
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches that drive actionable decisions
Partner with Data Scientists to identify areas of improvement for Data Science models  
Work with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams to operationalize our customer intelligence and make it accessible to the business
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear, actionable data storytelling
Build scalable reporting to measure progress in key initiatives 
Develop deep expertise in Autodesk’s customer and go-to-market data ecosystem
Work as an individual contributor with opportunities for leadership as we grow the team


Minimum Qualifications 


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or Business Analytics) or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
4+ years in an Analyst role 
Strong SQL coding skills and comfortable using it everyday 
Experience with Snowflake
Experience working in Python or R 
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) to accelerate data work, automate repetitive tasks, and improve analytical productivity
Comfortable with presenting data and storytelling using a variety of tools, ranging from PowerPoint to Power BI to Python


Preferred Qualifications 


Familiarity with Salesforce & Salesforce data objects
Familiarity with Data Science concepts 
Experience working in Git 
Experience working with DBT
Experience with Looker


The Ideal Candidate


Tells compelling stories using data – you weave together a narrative of what is happening in the business based on your analysis to help drive business decisions
Communicates effectively with both technical stakeholders and non-technical stakeholders 
Demonstrates intellectual curiosity by challenging assumptions, asking follow-up questions, and uncovering insights beyond the original request
Independently manages multiple workstreams while proactively communicating progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to stakeholders
Has a strong attention to detail and care deeply about data quality 
Proactively reaches out to stakeholders to understand the business use case better
Enjoys collaborating with team members to drive impact 


26WD99647, Analyste de données senior

Aperçu du Poste 

Autodesk recherche un analyste de données senior expérimenté pour rejoindre l’équipe « Strategic Data & Research » au sein de notre équipe « Go-To-Market Data Intelligence » (GDI). L’équipe GDI a pour mission de fournir des données de base précises et des informations sur les clients afin d’étayer l’action des équipes de commercialisation (GTM) tout au long du cycle de vie du client.

Les analystes de données jouent un rôle essentiel dans la définition des axes prioritaires de la stratégie de commercialisation (GTM) en mettant en évidence des informations pertinentes, en influençant les décisions commerciales et en collaborant avec les différentes fonctions pour fournir des informations clients utilisées tout au long du cycle de vie du client.

Nous sommes ouverts aux candidatures à distance basées au Canada.

Responsabilités 


Gérer des projets d’analyse de A à Z, de la définition du problème à la livraison, en identifiant les opportunités d’affiner le périmètre à mesure que de nouvelles informations émergent
Mener des analyses exploratoires, en s’appuyant sur le contexte métier et les données pour déterminer les prochaines questions auxquelles il convient de répondre, plutôt que de se contenter d’exécuter des demandes prédéfinies
Collaborer avec les chefs de projet pour explorer de nouvelles idées de projets ou des améliorations
Traduire des questions métier ambiguës en approches analytiques structurées qui conduisent à des décisions exploitables
Collaborer avec les data scientists pour identifier les axes d’amélioration des modèles de science des données
Travailler avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données et de Business Intelligence pour opérationnaliser nos informations clients et les rendre accessibles à l’entreprise
Présenter les conclusions et les recommandations aux parties prenantes, en influençant les décisions grâce à une présentation claire et exploitable des données
Mettre en place un système de reporting évolutif pour mesurer les progrès des initiatives clés
Développer une expertise approfondie de l’écosystème de données clients et de stratégie de commercialisation d’Autodesk
Travailler en tant que collaborateur autonome avec des opportunités d’évoluer vers des fonctions de direction à mesure que l’équipe s’agrandit


Qualifications Minimales 


Licence dans un domaine quantitatif (par exemple, statistiques, mathématiques, informatique, économie, science des données ou analyse de données d’entreprise) ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience professionnelle pertinente.
Au moins 4 ans d’expérience dans un poste d’analyste 
Solides compétences en codage SQL et aisance dans son utilisation quotidienne
Expérience avec Snowflake
Expérience de travail avec Python ou R 
Maîtrise des outils de développement assistés par l’IA (par exemple, Claude Code ou équivalent) pour accélérer le traitement des données, automatiser les tâches répétitives et améliorer la productivité analytique
Aisance dans la présentation des données et la narration à l’aide de divers outils, allant de PowerPoint à Power BI en passant par Python


Qualifications Souhaitées


Connaissance de Salesforce et des objets de données Salesforce
Connaissance des concepts de science des données 
Expérience de travail avec Git
Expérience de travail avec DBT
Expérience avec Looker


Le Candidat Idéal


Raconte des histoires captivantes à partir des données – vous tissez un récit de ce qui se passe dans l’entreprise en vous appuyant sur vos analyses afin de contribuer à orienter les décisions stratégiques
Communique efficacement tant avec les parties prenantes techniques que non techniques
Fait preuve de curiosité intellectuelle en remettant en question les hypothèses, en posant des questions complémentaires et en mettant au jour des informations allant au-delà de la demande initiale
Gère de manière autonome plusieurs axes de travail tout en communiquant de manière proactive sur l’avancement, les risques, les compromis et les recommandations aux parties prenantes
Fait preuve d’un grand souci du détail et accorde une grande importance à la qualité des données
Prend proactivement contact avec les parties prenantes pour mieux comprendre le cas d’utilisation métier
Aime collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe pour générer un impact


Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In this role, you will analyze large and complex data sets, define and track business KPIs, build automated reporting solutions, conduct robust analyses, generate actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations that inform critical decisions across strategy, product, marketing, and operations.

Build automated reports and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Mixpanel, etc.
Build and grow adoption of self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access data and insights, and hence accelerate data-driven decision making.
Conduct market and competitor analysis using a variety of internal and external data sources.
Work with Avail leadership team on strategic initiatives and planning, providing analytical support on financial modeling, forecast, opportunity sizing, and so on.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree, ideally in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
6+ years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
SQL proficiency is a must, with 6+ years of experience.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for quick reporting and ad hoc analysis.
Strong capability to work with complex data sets and perform EDA, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Snowflake and AWS.
Significant experience creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar tools.
Proven experience using data and analytics to drive revenue and other business KPIs, and doing so in a proactive manner by actively seeking to identify opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse technical and business audiences at different levels.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners.
Experience managing multiple priorities, responding to urgent data requests, and adapting to changing business needs and priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Experience in the tech sector, especially marketplace or property tech.

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off

Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs

Title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Loopback Health is hiring an innovative and team-oriented Data Analyst within the Health System Solutions team to work on a blend of clinical, economic and operational datasets to answer questions across the healthcare delivery and life sciences value chain.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

Duties to Include


Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs


Travel


Expected to be minimal.


This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Loopback

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Our work sits at the intersection of data, technology, and patient care, and we’re building a purpose-driven team that reflects that mission.

Founded in 2009, Loopback has been recognized by the Dallas Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work, reflecting a culture grounded in collaboration, trust, and impact. Loopback has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and consistently ranks among the fastest-growing companies in Dallas by the Dallas Business Journal.

Title: Data Analyst (HQ)
Description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

Koniag Services Inc., a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a talented and experienced Data Analyst to support headquarters-level data analysis, performance reporting, and strategic decision support for our IT Call Center program operations in the Washington, DC area. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a strong command of data analytics, reporting tools, and visualization platforms, and a demonstrated ability to synthesize complex, multi-site operational data into clear and compelling insights for senior leadership and government stakeholders. They bring a strategic perspective, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-visibility headquarters environment. Ability to obtain a government security clearance may be required to support Koniag Services Inc. and our government customers. This position is located in the Washington, DC area.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Position Description

The Headquarters Data Analyst will serve as a central analytical resource supporting the enterprise-wide performance monitoring, reporting, and data governance functions of the IT Call Center program. This individual will work closely with the Senior Program Manager, program leadership, and site-level operations teams to aggregate, analyze, and present program-wide performance data, support strategic planning activities, and ensure that all headquarters-level reporting requirements are met with accuracy and consistency. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:


Serve as the primary data analyst supporting headquarters-level program performance monitoring, aggregating and analyzing operational data from multiple call center sites to provide a comprehensive, enterprise-wide view of program performance.
Design, develop, and maintain advanced performance dashboards, scorecards, and analytical reports that provide senior program leadership and government stakeholders with timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into program-wide call center performance metrics.
Collect, validate, and consolidate operational data submissions from site-level operations teams, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and completeness of all data inputs prior to incorporation into headquarters-level reports and briefings.
Conduct in-depth analysis of program-wide operational data including call volumes, ticket trends, SLA compliance, first call resolution rates, escalation patterns, workforce utilization, and customer satisfaction scores, identifying cross-site trends, performance gaps, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Lead the preparation and quality assurance review of all headquarters-level customer-facing deliverables including monthly and quarterly performance reports, program scorecards, and executive briefing materials for senior government leadership.
Support the Senior Program Manager and headquarters leadership team in the development of data-driven strategic recommendations, program improvement initiatives, and resource allocation strategies informed by enterprise performance data.
Develop and maintain a program-wide operational metrics baseline and performance benchmarking framework, conducting regular comparisons across sites and against industry standards to identify best practices and areas requiring targeted improvement.
Collaborate with site-level operations analysts and program staff to ensure alignment of data definitions, reporting methodologies, and performance measurement standards across all program locations.
Support data governance activities including the development and enforcement of data quality standards, reporting templates, data dictionary maintenance, and analytical process documentation.
Assist in the management and continuous improvement of the program's data infrastructure, including ITSM platform reporting configurations, data extraction processes, and dashboard maintenance.
Prepare and present analytical findings, program performance summaries, and strategic recommendations to senior program leadership and government stakeholders in both written and verbal formats.
Respond to ad hoc data requests and analytical tasks from headquarters leadership and government stakeholders, delivering accurate, insightful, and well-presented outputs within established timelines.
Support continuous improvement initiatives at the headquarters level by identifying cross-site operational inefficiencies, analyzing root causes, and developing data-supported improvement recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities as needed, including supporting proposal efforts with program performance data, analytical capability narratives, and past performance documentation.


Required

Education and Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Operations Management, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
4+ years of experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analysis role, with demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-level or multi-site reporting functions.
Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining performance dashboards, analytical reports, and data visualization products for senior leadership and executive audiences.
Experience working within a federal government contracting environment.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources to produce consolidated, enterprise-level analytical outputs.


Preferred


Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.
Prior experience supporting headquarters or enterprise-level data analysis functions for a federal IT call center, service desk, or IT managed services program.
Experience working in a high-visibility, senior leadership-facing analytical role within a government contracting environment.


Required Skills And Competencies


Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to present complex data findings, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive-level government stakeholders and senior program leadership.
Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to aggregate, validate, and interpret large volumes of multi-source operational data to identify enterprise-wide trends, performance patterns, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, dynamic charting, and macro development for sophisticated operational reporting and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in data visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools, with demonstrated experience designing executive-level dashboards and interactive, multi-site analytical reports.
Proficiency in data querying languages such as SQL for extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from relational databases and ITSM platforms.
Hands-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or equivalent systems, including experience extracting and analyzing platform data for enterprise reporting purposes.
Working knowledge of IT service management principles and ITIL frameworks, including SLA governance, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
Strong data governance skills with experience developing and enforcing data quality standards, reporting templates, and analytical process documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for documentation, communication, and reporting purposes.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority deliverables simultaneously, maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced headquarters environment.
Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance as required.


Desired Skills And Competencies


Active government security clearance (Secret or higher).
ITIL Foundation certification or higher (ITIL Intermediate or ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
Experience with advanced analytics or statistical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data analysis and modeling.
Lean Six Sigma White Belt, Yellow Belt, or Green Belt certification.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or demonstrated project management experience supporting analytical programs.
Experience with enterprise data warehouse platforms, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, or equivalent data integration tools.
Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks and reporting requirements such as FITARA, FedRAMP, or NIST cybersecurity standards.
Experience supporting quality assurance (QA) programs and integrating customer satisfaction data into enterprise performance reporting frameworks.
