Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the world's leading agencies and brands. The Business Intelligence team plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. As a Senior Data Analyst on the BI team, you will own advanced reporting and analysis for multiple internal stakeholders, driving strategic planning and operational insights across the Advertising Technologies department.

This role is based in Canada. StackAdapt operates with a remote-first culture.

What You'll Be Doing:
Design and maintain advanced reporting solutions and dashboards that support stakeholder decision-making across multiple teams and business segments
Lead end-to-end data analysis projects, defining technical requirements for ETL processes and data models
Develop customized KPIs and metrics that quantify business performance, risks, and opportunities
Identify and resolve data quality issues, implementing validation frameworks and best practices across the BI team
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on reporting needs, probe assumptions, and communicate findings clearly at all levels
Own and deliver a portfolio of recurring and ad-hoc stakeholder reports with minimal supervision
Build or optimize at least two automated reporting workflows using available tools (including AI tools such as Claude or Gemini)
Establish strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders across the Advertising Technologies department
Document data definitions, reporting procedures, and ETL logic to reduce knowledge concentration risk
Participate actively in sprint planning and backlog prioritization for the BI team
Leverage AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and draft documentation

3+ years of experience in a data analytics role, with a strong track record of delivering advanced reporting for multiple stakeholder teams
Advanced SQL skills; ability to define ETL requirements and work with complex, heterogeneous datasets
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) and building client-facing or executive-ready dashboards
Strong communication skills with experience presenting data-driven findings to senior management and cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to identify data quality root causes and implement systematic solutions

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Looking for a career that challenges you, fosters growth, and recognizes your contributions—all while keeping things fun? At US HealthConnect (USH), we don’t just talk about our core values, we live them. With one of the industry’s highest employee retention rates, and a rapidly growing portfolio of healthcare clients and services, USH is a place where careers take root and thrive. As a leader in medical education, healthcare publishing, and pharmaceutical marketing services, we deliver relevant, practical information to healthcare professionals worldwide.




We’re currently seeking qualified candidates for a Data Analyst in our Fort Washington office. This position reports directly to the Analytics Manager and will be responsible for data gathering, analysis, and reporting.




What a day in the life of a Data Analyst looks like:

Acquire data from various internal and external data sources
Create reports for internal teams/external clients
Identify, analyze, and interpret patterns in data sets using statistical techniques
Derive and communicate data insights
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to data analysis and BI




Expectations of qualified candidates:

Have a bachelor’s degree (BS) in Mathematics or Computer Science
2+ years’ working experience as a Data Analyst or Data Scientist
Knowledge of Machine Learning is a plus
Knowledge of Query Languages such as SQL
Possesses strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate information with attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to generate information quickly and manage multiple projects at once
Ability to work extended hours as needed




What qualified candidates can expect:

Along with a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer a modern working environment that supports work/life balance. They value hard work and a positive, can-do attitude, and in return, fosters a fun, friendly, and team-oriented culture.




Interested? Please submit your resume and salary requirements. Submissions without salary requirements will not be considered. No phone calls please.




Salary will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. If required by applicable state or local laws, we will provide salary range information to candidates during the hiring process.

Our job listings are exclusively available on official sites (our careers page, LinkedIn and Indeed). Be cautious of other sources claiming to represent organizations.
Verify the legitimacy of any job postings. Visit our website career’s page to confirm the validity of any openings.
Verify communications. We will only contact you through company email addresses (e.g., ushealthconnect.com) and phone numbers.
Remember that during the application process, we will never request sensitive personal or financial information from you.
Our interviews are conducted through official channels (such as phone, or video calls). We do not conduct interviews via chat apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Discord.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Partnership Net is revolutionizing the €90B sponsorship industry with its innovative AI-powered Agent-as-a-Service platform. By transforming sponsorships into a transparent, data-driven, and measurable process, we empower brands and rights holders to optimize ROI, maximize value, and discover new opportunities. Our solutions enable organizations to shift from intuition-based decisions to insights derived from data analytics, driving effective partnerships in a continually evolving market. At Partnership Net, we are committed to setting new standards and delivering actionable intelligence for our clients.




Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role for a Data Analyst, located in the Greater Aveiro Area with some flexibility to work from home. As a Data Analyst with Partnership Net, you will analyze, interpret, and present data to support strategic business decisions. Core responsibilities will include collecting and preparing data, creating and refining data models, applying the highest quality standards, developing actionable insights, and effectively communicating findings to stakeholders. You will play a key role in transforming data into valuable business solutions to drive our company’s mission forward.




Qualifications

Proficiency in Analytical Skills, Data Analytics, and Statistics to analyze data and uncover insights.
Expertise in Data Modeling to design and implement effective database models for business needs.
Strong Communication skills to present data insights clearly to stakeholders and collaborate effectively with team members.
Proficient in using analytical tools and platforms such as SQL, Python, or R.
Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience implementing the highest quality standards and automation procedures.
Detail oriented with strong values working and collaborating towards the best result.
Ability to work in a hybrid environment, balancing in-office and remote work as needed.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Familiarity with the sponsorship or marketing industry is a plus.




Benefits

28 paid vacation days per year + birthday off
Public transport costs reimbursement
Health insurance
Monthly subscription service budget
10 min train journey from Aveiro to the office
Multinational young team environment
Hybrid working mode ﻿

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job title: DATA ANALYST

Location: Paris, France

Job reference #: 33732

Contract type: Permanent

Language requirements: Fluent in French and English




At Eni, we are looking for a Data Analyst to join Eni Plenitude France. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Finance, Sales, Operations and Customer Service, to transform data into actionable insights that drive business performance. You will play a key role in analysing, interpreting and enhancing data to support commercial growth, optimise the customer experience, address business needs and enable strategic decision-making, ultimately contributing to the company’s operational efficiency and long-term success.




About Plenitude




Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This partnership represents a major European project integrating the renewable energy business with the retail business, which will enable us to progressively increase our offering of services, infrastructure, and green energy for our customers, providing our team with greater visibility and professional growth.




Main Responsibilities




Data Collection and Processing: Extract, transform and structure data from a variety of internal and external sources.
Data Analysis: Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify trends, customer behaviours and performance drivers.
Data Visualisation and Reporting: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI) and establish and monitor business KPIs.
Advanced Analytics: Contribute to the development of models, forecasts and predictive analyses.
Optimisation and Recommendations: Provide actionable insights to improve processes, marketing campaigns and the customer experience.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical teams, including IT, developers and data scientists, while partnering with business departments to understand analytical needs and business objectives.
Data Culture: Promote data-driven decision-making and support internal teams in the effective use of data and KPI management.




Skills And Experience Required




Bachelor's or Master's degree (BSc/MSc) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
Proficiency in data visualisation tools, particularly Power BI.
Good knowledge of data analysis languages and tools, including SQL, Python and R.
Experience with Big Data and/or Cloud environments (Azure, Google Cloud Platform or AWS) would be an advantage.
Significant experience in data analysis.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, meaningful and impactful insights for different audiences.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across multiple functions.
Well-organised, self-motivated and capable of managing priorities independently.
Results-oriented, with strong influencing and communication skills.
Fluent in English.




How To Apply




Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
Please upload your CV in English.




About Eni




Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.




Working at Eni




At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.




Energy for action takers

Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.

Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.





Description du poste

NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Senior H/F, en CDI, à Bordeaux !

Ton futur environnement de travail :

Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos grands comptes clients. Ton rôle sera d'accompagner les directions métiers dans la valorisation de leur patrimoine data. Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, de la phase d'exploration à l'exposition des résultats.

Tes missions :

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des cas d'usage concrets par le croisement de sources de données complexes (ciblage marketing, analyses descriptives ou modèles prédictifs).

  • Développer, optimiser et assurer la maintenance de solutions de données réutilisables, garantissant ainsi l'agilité et l'efficacité des analyses à long terme.

  • Transformer des données brutes en insights actionnables via la création et la publication de dashboards clairs et percutants.

  • Garantir la qualité des livrables en respectant rigoureusement les normes techniques et les bonnes pratiques définies au sein de l'équipe Data.

  • Jouer un rôle d'ambassadeur de la donnée en accompagnant les équipes métiers dans la compréhension des résultats et le développement de leur culture "Data Driven".





Qualifications

De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu possèdes au minimum 6 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Agile/SCRUM.

Tu justifies d'une expérience solide dans le domaine de la Data (manipulation de bases de données, SQL, outils d'analyse).

Tu as une appétence pour l'utilisation de Snowflake.

Pédagogue et rigoureux, tu traduis des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes pour des interlocuteurs non-experts.

Tu maitrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.

▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours.

▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser.

▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir.

▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you see the benefits of gaining variety and experience from different customers and industries but developing with one and the same employer? As an employee at ESSIQ, you get the best of both worlds.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst with a strong technical foundation in data engineering to join our team. In this role, you’ll manage multiple data and reporting solutions across different technologies.

You’ll work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams — acting as the key bridge between business needs and data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights:

Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights that drive informed decision-making.

Visualization & Reporting:

Design and develop dashboards and reports in Power BI to communicate insights effectively.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to turn business requirements into actionable data models and analytics solutions.

Required Skills & Experience


Strong proficiency in SQL and Power BI
Proven experience in Business Intelligence or Advanced Analytics projects
Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
Experience in requirement gathering, process understanding, and solution design


Soft Skills & Working Style


Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills
Comfortable collaborating across international teams and time zones
Adaptable, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies
Skilled in virtual collaboration tools for effective teamwork in global settings


About Essiq

ESSIQ is the technology consultancy where everything starts with the individual. We offer you the opportunity to shape your own career, a modern salary policy and flexible solutions! ESSIQ was founded in 2005 and has since grown with over 130 employees and three offices that you can find in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö. With us, you have the opportunity to work on site with the client, in-house and in satellite. Your interests and driving forces lead the way and our goal is to make the perfect match between individual and mission.

ESSIQ is a social company. We put a lot of resources into community and we have a wide range of professional and social activities. Our communication platform is imbued with openness and promotes networking and skill exchange as well as leisure activities and relationship building.

APPLICATION

Selection and interviews will take place continuously, so send your application today! Please respect that we do not accept any applications by email.

Questions about the role? Contact: Fredrik Persson, fredrik.persson@essiq.se

Do you want to know more about ESSIQ?

Visit http://essiq.se and follow us on our social media!

Description De L'entreprise

Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques. Pour les entreprises, les acteurs publics et la société dans son ensemble, les 28 000 consultants et spécialistes du groupe visent chaque jour l'impact digital : des solutions qui contribuent à la performance, à l'innovation et au bien commun.

Présent dans 19 pays au plus près des territoires, et avec ses grands partenaires éditeurs de logiciels, Inetum répond aux enjeux de la transformation digitale avec proximité et flexibilité.

Porté par son ambition de croissance et d'industrialisation, Inetum a généré en 2023 un chiffre d'affaires de 2,5 milliards d'€.

Pour répondre à un marché en croissance continue depuis plus de 30ans, Inetum a fait le choix délibéré de se recentrer sur 4 métiers afin de gagner en puissance et proposer des solutions sur mesure, adaptées aux besoins spécifiques de ses clients : le conseil (Inetum Consulting), la gestion des infrastructures et applications à façon (Inetum Technologies), l'implémentation de progiciels (Inetum Solutions) et sa propre activité d'éditeur de logiciels (Inetum Software). Inetum a conclu des partenariats stratégiques avec 4 grands éditeurs mondiaux - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft et SAP et poursuit une stratégie d'acquisitions dédiée afin d'entrer dans le top 5 européen sur ces technologies et proposer la meilleure expertise à ses clients.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Description Du Poste

En tant que Data Analyst, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la collecte, l'analyse et la valorisation des données afin d'accompagner les équipes métier dans leurs prises de décision.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée, depuis la collecte et la transformation jusqu'à la création de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de pilotage. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes métiers, les chefs de projet et les équipes techniques pour produire des analyses pertinentes permettant d'améliorer la performance et le suivi de l'activité.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : 


Collecter, consolider et analyser les données issues de différentes sources.
Définir, mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPIs).
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord et reportings décisionnels.
Analyser les tendances et produire des recommandations basées sur les données.
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données exploitées.
Participer à l'identification des besoins métiers et à leur traduction en indicateurs pertinents.
Produire des analyses régulières et des synthèses à destination des parties prenantes.
Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de reporting et d'analyse.
Collaborer avec les équipes métiers, projets et techniques dans le cadre d'études et d'analyses de données.


Qualifications

Fort d'au moins 3 ans d'expériences, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques dans des domaines tels que :


Très bonne maîtrise de SQL.
Maîtrise de Power BI ou d'un outil de datavisualisation équivalent.
Bonne maîtrise d'Excel.
Connaissances en modélisation et manipulation de données.
Capacité à analyser et interpréter des données complexes.
Connaissance des environnements décisionnels et du reporting.
Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse.


Vous aimez évoluer dans des environnements techniques complexes et innovants. Vous avez un véritable esprit d’équipe et aimez partager vos connaissances pour faire avancer la dynamique collective. Rigueur, adaptabilité et sens du service font partie de votre ADN professionnel.

Qualités personnelles


Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de l’écoute
Capacité à convaincre et fédérer les parties prenantes
Très bonnes compétences rédactionnelles
Forte capacité d’analyse, esprit de synthèse
Rigueur, autonomie et sens du service


Informations supplémentaires

L'évolution Professionnelle Au Sein D'Inetum 

Chez Inetum, nous croyons en votre développement et nous vous accompagnons à chaque étape grâce à :


Des formations et certifications régulières pour rester à la pointe des technologies,
Du temps dédié à la montée en compétence sur de nouvelles solutions.


Ce Que Nous Offrons 


Un environnement technologique stimulant et des projets stratégiques.
Une équipe experte et collaborative, où vos compétences seront valorisées.
Accompagnement personnalisé par Inetum pour booster votre carrière.


 

✅ Congés & RTT 

Les avantages Inetum qui font la différence :


27 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT (dès 1 an d'acquisition)
1 jour supplémentaire tous les 5 ans d’ancienneté
Congés exceptionnels (dont 1 jour pour déménagement)


💙 Santé & Bien-être 


Mutuelle premium (65 % pris en charge)
Affiliation gratuite des enfants + option conjoint
Téléconsultation médicale gratuite
Prévoyance complète


🚲 Mobilité 


Remboursement transport en commun à 50 %
Indemnité vélo jusqu’à 200 €/an


💰 Avantages Financiers 


Dispositif de participation + Plan d’Épargne Groupe
Action logement (aide pour achat, travaux, location)


🏡 Télétravail 


Dispositif en place depuis 2011
Indemnité mensuelle (15 € / mois)
Participation aux frais d'installation


🍽 Tickets Restaurant 


9 € par jour travaillé (60 % pris en charge par l'employeur)


🤝 Cooptation 


Prime de 500 € à 1500 €


🎉 Vie D’entreprise 


Activités sociales & culturelles
Événements festifs d’équipe


🧘 Qvt

Maintien de salaire pour les congés maternité après 6 mois d'ancienneté

Title: Data Analyst Senior H/F
Description:
💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c'est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :




✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

✔️Des missions à forte valeur ajoutée : Dans des secteurs variés, avec une approche "sur mesure" où nos solutions ont des impacts importants chez nos clients.

✔️Une culture d’excellence technique : Avec un réel accompagnement de carrière et un suivi personnalisé.

✔️Une équipe passionnée et engagée : Des ingénieurs recrutés avec soin, formés en continu, et investis sur le long terme.

✔️L’agilité d’une startup, la rigueur d’un cabinet expert : Le meilleur des deux mondes pour une expérience enrichissante.

✔️Des missions à impact, visibles et valorisantes : Où vous aurez un impact réel sur les décisions métiers et la valeur business générée.




📍 Localisation : Paris (75002) avec 2-3 jours de télétravail hebdomadaire

💶 Rémunération : A discuter selon vos prétentions

🗓️ Démarrage : ASAP

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About This Vacancy

You will work with diverse datasets to identify trends, monitor performance, and deliver actionable recommendations that help stakeholders achieve their objectives.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and visualize data, translating complex information into clear and impactful reports and dashboards.


Define data requirements, reporting needs, and analytical approaches based on business objectives and project requirements.
Perform data extraction, exploration, and analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support data-driven decision making.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical tools to monitor business performance and support operational and strategic initiatives.
Conduct data quality checks, validate analytical outputs, troubleshoot data issues, and produce clear documentation to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting and analysis.


What We Expect From You


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Previous experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or related analytical roles.
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python and Microsoft Excel for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, or similar platforms.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI definition and monitoring, dashboard development, performance reporting, and business insights generation.
Experience working with large and complex datasets, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and data modeling concepts is considered a plus.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL processes, and cloud-based analytics platforms is considered a plus.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Good oral and written communication skills, both in Italian and English


What You Can Expect From Us

The position offers a permanent employment contract, and the base gross annual salary (Gross Annual Salary – RAL) will be no less than €30,000, in line with the National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) for Commerce – Tertiary, Distribution and Services.

TMC is committed to offering a competitive compensation package. At the end of the recruitment process, after assessing the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications, the company may offer a final gross annual salary higher than the amount stated above.

In line with our business model, the final compensation package also includes a project profit-sharing component, an individual annual learning and development budget of €4,000 net, and an annual welfare allowance. Further details will be provided during the recruitment process, in accordance with the company's applicable policies.

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

Title: Data Analyst

Conetic is an innovative global company dedicated to transforming the flying experience by making the passenger journey engaging and truly memorable.

Conduct complex data analysis and report on results;
Interpret trends and patterns
Evaluate business needs and objectives
Analyze and organize raw information from different sources
Build data systems, pipelines, algorithms and prototypes
Develop analytical tools and programs
Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability
Prepare data for prescriptive and predictive modeling
Identify opportunities for data acquisition
Collaborate with data scientists and architects on several projects


About you:


Strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems with data.
Proficient in SQL
Experienced with Power BI and Python
Comfortable working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple sources.
Skilled in using statistical techniques and data modeling to uncover insights.

Detail-oriented, with the ability to translate raw data into clear and actionable insights.
Collaborative and communicative, able to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Curious, proactive, and eager to improve processes and contribute to innovation.


About the benefits:


Flexible working hours;
International team;
Birthday Leave;

Title: Data Analyst BI expérimenté
Description:
Synanto est une ESN à taille humaine avec un management de proximité, une culture et des valeurs qui inscrivent nos collaborateurs au cœur de son développement. En effet, la relation avec nos consultants est un des leviers de notre proposition de valeur nous permettant d'instaurer une relation durable, tout en les accompagnant à devenir des experts.

En ce sens, intégrer Synanto - devenir un Talent ∑ - c'est l'assurance de se voir proposer des missions stimulantes et d'évoluer en ayant un véritable plan de carrière.

Nos secteurs d'intervention sont variés (Industrie, Energie, Transports, Distribution, Edition de logiciels ou Secteur public), avec une expertise qui reste dominante dans le secteur Banque, Finance et Assurance.

Aujourd'hui, Synanto, Ce Sont


4 agences en France (Paris, Lyon, Aix-en-Provence et Montpellier) et 2 à l'étranger (Luxembourg et Tunisie)
260 collaborateurs
1 spécialisation dans le domaine Banque | Finance | Assurance
1 promesse : Vos Projets, Nos Talents, Une Rencontre
5 valeurs fortes : Synergie, Entraide, Transparence, Diversité, Optimisme


De nombreux talents ont déjà rejoint notre équipe, pour une vision différente, des opportunités de carrière et des projets innovants. Pourquoi pas vous !?... Venez écrire l'histoire d'une entreprise, experte des SI à dimension humaine.

POSTE / MISSIONS

Nous recherchons un.e Data Analyst BI expérimenté pour accompagner les squads de l'entreprise dans la conception et la réalisation de leurs cas d'usages data.

Les Missions Seront Les Suivantes


Collaborer avec les Business Analystes pour identifier les besoins métiers et les traduire en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI),
Analyser et explorer les données, les restituer sous forme d'analyses descriptives ou de tableaux de bord (Microstrategy) en lien avec les problématiques métiers,
Requêter et extraire des données via des scripts SQL (pour analyse ou besoins opérationnels),
Présenter les résultats aux équipes métiers (animation devant un public large), interpréter les analyses et formuler des recommandations,
Véhiculer le cadre de gouvernance Data (Data Management, Data Privacy) et porter les expertises autour du Digital,
Documenter les analyses, méthodologies et guides utilisateurs ; maintenir, optimiser et améliorer les rapports/dashboards existants ainsi que les processus analytiques.


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Vous disposez de 5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste similaire.

Vous Maitrisez


Langage : SQL (Niveau Expert requis),
Data Visualisation : Niveau Expert (BI ou Tableau, Microstrategy est un plus),
Bases de données SQL : Requis (Teradata apprécié),
IA / Développement : Exploitation et maîtrise de GitHub Copilot dans la pratique BI,
Méthodologie Agile Scrum,
Gouvernance & Protection des données : conformité réglementaire (RGPD),


Vous êtes bon communicant.e et pédagogue. Vous êtes adaptable et force de proposition.

Vous avez un bon esprit d'analyse et une capacité à challenger les besoins des métiers pour proposer la solution la plus adaptée.

Description Du Poste

leboncoin, est le 1er site généraliste de vente entre particuliers en France, leader sur les marchés de l’immobilier et l’automobile, acteur clé sur les biens de consommation de seconde main et sur l’emploi. Accélérer la croissance de cette activité dans un contexte fortement concurrentiel
Optimiser l’expérience utilisateur (spécialisation de l’expérience, réassurance, conversion)
Renforcer la position de leader de marché, en hyper spécialisant l’expérience et le parcours pour les acheteurs et les vendeurs


Exigences du poste


Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Data Analyst au sein d’un pure player de la tech (idéalement une marketplace)
Forte culture business, capacité à formuler des recommandations pertinentes et à construire un partenariat avec des clients en interne
Excellente maîtrise de SQL et Python
Expérience en genAI et ou self-service Analytics
Expérience avec des outils de datavisualisation (idéalement Tableau)
Solides capacités d’analyse et de synthèse
Autonomie, rigueur et sens des priorités
Curiosité, esprit critique et force de proposition
Goût pour le travail en équipe et le partage de connaissances


Responsabilités liées au poste

Piloter la performance business du périmètre Immobilier


Accompagner les équipes Métiers et Produit dans la prise de décision data-driven
Mesurer l’impact des évolutions business et produit
Se positionner comme business partner et relai des équipes Data de l’entreprise auprès des stakeholders.


Structurer le pilotage et les indicateurs


Accompagner les équipes dans la définition de KPI pertinents, alignés avec leurs objectifs
Être proactif dans la mise en place, l’exploitation et l’amélioration de dashboards
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la lisibilité des indicateurs, en collaborant avec les équipes Data Engineering et Data gouvernance.


Veille et culture Data


Assurer une veille active sur les tendances en analyse de données, outils et méthodologies
Contribuer au développement des best practices de l’équipe Data Analytics
Porter et diffuser la culture Data au sein de l’entreprise


Avantages du poste


Conditions de travail agréables (locaux, télétravail…)
Rémunération attractive (fixe, variable et participation)
Opportunités de développement professionnel rapides et personnalisées
Carte tickets restaurants
Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance efficace et compétitive


Chez leboncoin, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des points de vue est une richesse essentielle. Cet engagement se reflète pleinement dans notre processus de recrutement : nous évaluons chaque candidature uniquement au regard des compétences, de l’expérience et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part : nous serons ravis de vous accompagner.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join the Future of Data & Analytics at The Ardonagh Group

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an exciting new operation established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. As a centre of excellence for data and analytics, the Lab delivers data-driven insights that support colleagues and clients across the globe.

With more than 12,000 colleagues operating across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and related services, Ardonagh is committed to using data to transform decision-making, enhance client outcomes, and build a deeper understanding of risk.

Our mission is simple: use data, analytics, and innovation to achieve better outcomes for every participant in the value chain. We explore vast and complex datasets, uncover hidden opportunities, model future scenarios, and help clients and insurer partners prepare for the unknown.

We're now looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics Team and play a pivotal role in turning data into meaningful business insight.

The Opportunity

As a key member of the Data Analytics Team, you will work across a variety of datasets to both respond to business requests and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance across the Group.

You will bridge the gap between our Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams, ensuring that data is transformed into valuable insights that drive decision-making, operational efficiency, and commercial success.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically curious professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing strategic decisions through data.

What You'll Be Doing


Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform decision-making, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams to understand available data sources and maximise their business value.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities within large datasets and provide recommendations that support strategic business decisions.
Enhance automated reporting and dashboards through proactive analysis, meaningful commentary, and actionable recommendations.
Support the development and implementation of robust data governance, management, and reporting processes across the Group.
Explore and apply AI and machine learning techniques where appropriate to drive innovation and enhance business insight.
Contribute to the continued development of a world-class analytics function within the Ardonagh Analytics Lab.


What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years' experience in data analysis and reporting.
Strong SQL expertise, including data querying, mining, manipulation, and segmentation.
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets.
At least 2 years' experience using statistical programming languages such as Python or R.
Solid understanding of database concepts, structures, and data modelling.
Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence principles and analytical best practices.
Experience with one or more BI tools, including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.


Desirable Experience


Experience within financial services.
Previous exposure to General Insurance is highly advantageous.
Knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-based analytical techniques.


About You

We're looking for someone who:


Is an experienced analytics professional capable of working independently and taking ownership of outcomes.
Brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Has a genuine passion for transforming data into business value.
Quickly builds an understanding of business operations and technical environments.
Is a strong relationship builder who can confidently engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication and influencing skills.


Why Join Us?

At the Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact projects that influence decision-making across a global organisation. You'll join a collaborative team passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and unlocking the power of data to shape the future of insurance.

If you're excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into meaningful business outcomes and want to be part of a growing analytics centre of excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

If you approach life with a sense of adventure you might just find what you need at Ardonagh to bring your ambition to life.

Find out more about Ardonagh’s world of opportunity on LinkedIn or visit www.ardonagh.com.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to start a new professional challenge? Check out our new opportunity!

We are looking to incorporate a Data Analyst to our team.

🤗 About us

We are an IT Consultant Group that provides services and creates digital solutions to improve the lives of citizens across Europe. Check out our website: www.altia.es/en

🚀 Our project and team

This is your opportunity to start working on international projects with a highly qualified team and applying the latest technologies.

You will join our European team, specifically the one involved in several projects for a significant European Agency.

Minimum Requirements

🧠 Required Knowledge


Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting.
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable datasets.
High level of English.


✅ Main Responsibilities


Collect and clean data from various sources.
Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.


🔝 Skills:


Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
My client based in Westmeath is seeking a Data Analyst to join an established and expanding data team. This is a perm role. The position will focus on using data to answer key business questions, improve performance and support better commercial and operational decisions. You'll work with a broad range of datasets and collaborate with teams across data, technology and the wider business.




The role offers plenty of scope to go beyond standard reporting, with an emphasis on investigating data, spotting patterns and providing recommendations that can make a measurable difference. You'll take ownership of analytical requirements from initial investigation through to presenting findings and recommendations.




Key responsibilities will include:

Interrogate and analyse large, complex datasets to answer business questions and uncover useful insights.
Identify patterns, emerging trends, potential risks and opportunities for performance improvement.
Develop analysis that supports commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.
Work alongside Data Engineers to understand data availability, quality and structure.
Collaborate with reporting and visualisation specialists to improve dashboards and management information.
Add context and interpretation to reporting, helping stakeholders understand what the data means and what actions should be considered.
Communicate findings in a straightforward and engaging way to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
Help improve data quality, governance and analytical processes.
Investigate opportunities to introduce more advanced analytics, including machine learning and AI techniques.
Contribute ideas and best practices as the organisation continues to develop its data and analytics capabilities.




The successful candidate will have:

5+ years' professional experience working in data analysis, analytics or reporting.
A relevant third-level qualification in areas such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems or a similar discipline.
Strong hands-on SQL experience and confidence working with large datasets.
Experience with data extraction, transformation, manipulation and segmentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn raw data into useful business conclusions.
2+ years' experience using Python or R for data analysis.
A solid understanding of databases, data models and data structures.
Good knowledge of Business Intelligence concepts and reporting practices.
Practical experience with at least one major BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.




Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

Financial services or another highly data-driven sector.
Predictive modelling or advanced analytics.
Machine learning or AI-related analytical projects.




You'll be comfortable taking ownership of your workload and working through analytical problems with limited supervision. You'll have the curiosity to dig deeper into the data rather than simply producing reports based on predefined requirements.

You'll also need strong stakeholder skills. The role involves working with people across technical and business functions, so being able to explain analytical concepts and recommendations clearly is essential.

Funciones


Recopilar, limpiar y estructurar datos de diferentes fuentes.
Elaborar reporting operativo y ejecutivo y análisis de KPIs.

Participar en iniciativas de IA y Machine Learning aplicadas al negocio.
Trabajar con equipos de Business, PMO y Tecnología para traducir necesidades en soluciones de datos.

Tendrás horario flexible.
Te integrarás en un equipo internacional.
Trabajarás en modelo híbrido acudiendo 2 días/semana a la oficina de Sant Cugat del Vallès. Buena accesibilidad tanto en transporte público como aparcamiento.
Tendrás un PC y los periféricos necesarios para el desarrollo de tu trabajo.

🏥 Seguro médico: cobertura médica privada para empleados.

🤝 Acompañamiento personalizado: apoyo continuo del equipo de Talento y seguimientos mensuales.

🌐 Networking y comunidad: participación en BETWEEN Nights, torneos deportivos y otros eventos.

🎁 Programa de recomendación: incentivos económicos por referir talento a la compañía.

Requisitos

Mínimos


Formación en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Analytics, Informática o similar.
Dominio del inglés (avanzado/bilingüe) y español.
5+ años de experiencia en Data Analytics / BI.
Experiencia con:
Power BI, DAX y Power Query
SQL
Excel avanzado
Python (Pandas, NumPy)
Conocimientos básicos de IA / Machine Learning.
Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y orientación a mejora continua.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.


Valorables


Power Automate / Power Apps.
Microsoft Azure / Fabric, Azure Data Factory o Azure SQL.
Scikit-learn, modelos predictivos o forecasting.
Experiencia con otros entornos cloud (AWS / GCP).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.
You own our semantic layer, the metric definitions, business logic and data models that make sure there is one trusted answer to any business question, for people and for AI.
You own the implementation and evolution of our self-service analytics tools, so internal stakeholders can answer their own recurring questions.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry covering Finance, Product, Sales and Operations perspective, and engage with Business stakeholders to define KPIs, including how data is captured, shared and leveraged across departments.


Your Basic Qualifications


Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)


We are also interested in


Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

BizAway avoids any discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, health status, nationality, political opinions, and religious beliefs in all decisions affecting personnel selection.

Title: Data Analyst Senior (F/H)
Description:
Leader mondial de l’Ingénierie et du Conseil en Technologies, ALTEN offre des opportunités uniques pour développer vos compétences et évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Fort de plus de 35 ans d’expérience, le groupe ALTEN est présent dans plus de 30 pays. Grâce à ses 57 000 collaborateurs, dont 88 % d’ingénieurs, ALTEN s’impose comme un acteur international majeur et un leader de son marché.

Vous souhaitez accompagner des transformations majeures au sein de grands groupes industriels, financiers ou technologiques ? Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à la réussite de projets de changement à fort impact organisationnel et humain.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?


Une démarche RSE forte : nos équipes interviennent sur des projets contribuant à un avenir plus durable. ALTEN Group est signataire et membre de plusieurs programmes engagés (Planet Tech’Care, Charte de l’ingénierie, Climate Ambition Accelerator).
Les compétences au cœur de nos priorités : accompagnement personnalisé, formations continues et évolution de carrière tout au long de votre parcours.
Une culture d’entreprise riche et stimulante : événements fédérateurs, actions solidaires, webinaires innovation, challenges techniques… un environnement propice au partage et à l’épanouissement professionnel.


Description Du Poste

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous serez au cœur de l’analyse et de l’exploitation des données pour accompagner nos clients dans leur transformation digitale.

Analyse et Modélisation des Données :

Concevoir et développer des solutions d’analyse avancée pour répondre aux besoins métiers (optimisation des stocks, analyse des ventes, comportement client, etc.).

Exploiter des outils comme GCP (Google Cloud Platform), BigQuery, dbt et Looker pour extraire, transformer et visualiser des données massives.

Automatiser des rapports et tableaux de bord pour faciliter la prise de décision.

Collaboration et Innovation :

Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers, les Data Engineers et les Data Scientists pour traduire les besoins fonctionnels en solutions data.

Participer à la veille technologique et proposer des innovations pour répondre aux enjeux du secteur de la Grande Distribution.

Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus d’analyse et de gouvernance des données.

Qualifications

Diplômé(e) d’un Bac +5 (école d’ingénieurs, statistique, économétrie, ou spécialisation en Data).

7 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que Data Analyst, avec une expertise avérée sur :

GCP (Google Cloud Platform) et BigQuery pour le traitement de données à grande échelle.

dbt pour la transformation et la modélisation des données.

Looker pour la visualisation et le partage des insights.

Expérience dans le secteur de la Grande Distribution (un atout majeur).

Maîtrise des outils SQL avancé, Python (Pandas, NumPy) et des bonnes pratiques en data governance.

Mobile en Île-de-France et recherchant un poste en CDI.

Rigoureux(se), analytique et orienté(e) solution, vous aimez relever des défis techniques et travailler sur des projets concrets à fort impact.

Informations supplémentaires

Ce que nous offrons :


Un environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif.
Des opportunités de développement professionnel et de formation continue.
Un package de rémunération compétitif.
Des avantages sociaux attractifs.


Type de contrat : CDI

Rejoignez ALTEN et donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière !

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y !

Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer

Curieux, poser des questions est votre seconde nature

Analytique, vous avez une âme d’enquêteur et les énigmes n’ont aucun secret pour vous

Vous serez intégré(e) dans une équipe de consultants innovants et motivés, composée de Business Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers spécialisés sur les problématiques Data Analytics. À ce titre, vous interviendrez de façon opérationnelle sur des missions de conseil autour des sujets de transformation Data Analytics, de retraitement et modélisation de données et de représentation visuelle de la donnée pour adresser des problématiques métiers.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


Comprendre les problématiques métier,
Collecter et traiter les données en vue de l'analyse, incluant notamment la création de variables agrégées et complémentaires aux données brutes,
Automatiser et d’industrialiser les retraitements effectués sur les données,
Représenter les résultats dans un outil de restitution visuelle de façon ergonomique et intuitive,
Restituer les analyses au client notamment pas la création d’indicateurs pertinents pour les questions stratégiques des entreprises


Profil recherché

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 3 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :


Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils et méthodologies de Data Analytics, incluant notamment des bases techniques (modèles de données, langage SQL, …) mais également méthodologiques,
Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie d'Excel et maitrisez les langages statistiques tels que R, Python ou SAS,
Une connaissance d'un logiciel ou langage dédié à la Data Visualization (Tableau, Qliksense ou Qlickview, Microsoft Power BI…) ainsi que des compétences en automatisation (VBA par exemple) seraient un plus.


Processus de recrutement


Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique
Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution
Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays
