Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
Shape the Future of Data-Driven Airline Operations

Shape the Future of Data-Driven Airline Operations

At SAS, data plays a critical role in keeping our operation running safely, efficiently, and reliably. We are looking for a curious and driven Data Analyst who wants to turn complex data into meaningful insights that help shape decisions across one of Scandinavia's most dynamic operational environments.

As a Data Analyst within SAS Operations, you will work at the heart of our airline business, partnering with stakeholders across Airline Operations, Ground Handling, Fleet Line Maintenance, Operations Control Center, Resource Management, and Global Line Stations.

You will join our Data Analytics team, where your work will directly influence operational performance, resource planning, and strategic decision-making. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise, business understanding, and storytelling skills to create solutions that make a real impact across the organization.

The challenges You will work on

As a Data Analyst, you will transform data into actionable insights that help our stakeholders make smarter and faster decisions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Designing, developing, and maintaining insightful Power BI dashboards and reports.
Translating business needs and operational challenges into analytical solutions.
Identifying trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis.
Supporting management with ad hoc analyses and decision-support materials.
Ensuring reporting accuracy, quality, and alignment with business requirements.
Driving process improvements through data-driven recommendations.
Presenting findings and recommendations to leaders and stakeholders across the business.
Turning complex data into clear, engaging, and actionable stories.


What Makes This Role Exciting


Work with data that supports the daily operation of an international airline.
Collaborate with stakeholders across a broad range of operational functions.
Influence business decisions at both tactical and strategic levels.
Be part of a team that is accelerating SAS's journey toward data-driven decision-making.
Help shape new analytics solutions and continuously improve how insights are delivered across the organization.


To be successful we believe you have

You are passionate about using data to solve business challenges and communicate insights that drive action. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and finding opportunities to improve processes and performance.

You Bring


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
A data-driven mindset and attention to detail.
The ability to communicate complex concepts in a simple and engaging way.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation.


Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has:


At least 2-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience with Power BI and data visualization.
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, and data modelling.
Experience translating business challenges into analytical solutions.
A Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.


It Would Be a Plus If You Have


Experience from the airline, aviation, transportation, or operations industry.
Experience with automation, data modelling, or advanced analytics.
Relevant certifications in analytics, BI, or data management.


Why SAS?

At SAS, you will be part of a company undergoing an exciting transformation, where innovation, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making are key to our future success. You'll work alongside passionate colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and see the impact of your work reflected in the daily operation of Scandinavia's leading airline.

Benefits

We offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travellers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

Additional information

Ready to join us?

We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as we review applications and conduct interviews continuously. The position may be filled before the application deadline.

Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we are unable to process applications received via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

We might use online tests and an on-demand interview tool to give more applicants the opportunity to engage with us.


Employment Type: Full-time (100%) position with a 6-month probation period.
Location: Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm). We value in-person collaboration and expect you to work primarily from the office, while offering flexibility for remote work upon agreement with your leader.


Come and fly with us!

Rejoignez Scalian en Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur !

Scalian est un acteur majeur du conseil et de l'ingénierie, présent en région PACA et spécialisé dans trois domaines clés :

  • Operations Excellence – Optimisation des organisations et des processus
  • Digital Solutions – Transformation numérique, data, IA, développement logiciel
  • Systems & Software Engineering – Systèmes complexes, logiciels embarqués, ingénierie système

Nous accompagnons des secteurs stratégiques tels que l'Aérospatiale & Défense, l'Énergie & Life Science, la Mobility, la Banque/Assurance, l'Industrie et les Services.

Votre rôle

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités dans le secteur Défense, nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst pour accompagner nos clients dans l'exploitation et la valorisation de leurs données. Vous contribuerez à transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables pour la prise de décision opérationnelle et stratégique.

Vos missions

  • Collecter, nettoyer et structurer des données issues de sources multiples
  • Concevoir des tableaux de bord et rapports d'analyse à destination des équipes métier
  • Réaliser des analyses statistiques et identifier des tendances pertinentes
  • Participer à la définition des indicateurs de performance (KPI)
  • Assurer la fiabilité et la qualité des données produites
  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour optimiser les processus de traitement de données

Ce que nous recherchons chez vous

  • Formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur, université ou équivalent) en data, statistiques ou informatique

  • Bonne capacité d'analyse et de synthèse

  • Autonomie et esprit d'équipe
  • Une habilitation de sécurité (ou l'éligibilité à son obtention) peut être requise compte tenu du secteur d'activité

Compétences techniques souhaitées

  • Maîtrise des outils de data visualisation (Power BI, Tableau ou équivalents)
  • Maîtrise de SQL et d'un langage de traitement de données (Python ou R)
  • Connaissance des bases de données relationnelles
  • Sensibilité aux enjeux et contraintes du secteur Défense

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Le Poste

En tant que Data Analyst rattaché(e) au Pôle Pilotage commercial de la Direction de la Distribution, vous contribuez à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et le traitement des données en assurant la consolidation des objectifs commerciaux.

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos Missions Principales

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :


Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.


Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Expérience Souhaitée


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.


Qualités personnelles :


Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.
Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.
Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.


Outils Informatiques


Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.


Nos Avantages


Accord d’intéressement
Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
22,5 jours de RTT par an
Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations


Le processus de recrutement :


Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur


Chez Harmonie Mutuelle, votre métier contribue à une ambition collective : agir sur la santé de tous et prendre soin de chacun !


Nous sommes une entreprise mutualiste à mission et notre engagement est concret, porté par des actions de prévention, de conseil, d'accompagnement et de solidarité qui ont un vrai impact sur la vie de nos adhérents.
Nous encourageons les parcours singuliers : vous pouvez apprendre, évoluer, changer de métier ou de région grâce à la mobilité interne au sein du Groupe Vyv. L'important, c'est que votre trajectoire vous ressemble.
Nous savons que la diversité et l'inclusion sont une force, c'est pourquoi nous cultivons les différences et soutenons chaque individu. Nous luttons activement contre les discriminations et accompagnons, par exemple, nos salariés dans les moments de fragilité (maladies chroniques, aidance…). Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!

Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.

Gemeinsam mit über 20.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.

Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker-Gruppe.




Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d)




Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) für den Bereich Operative Logistik. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unternehmensweite KPI- und Monitoring Systeme, die täglich vom Senior Management und operativen Stakeholdern genutzt werden und gestaltest die datengetriebene Entscheidungskultur in der operativen Logistik aktiv mit. Du bist nah an den Prozessen und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen.




Dein Liefergebiet:

Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für unternehmensweite KPI- und Steuerungsframeworks, von der Konzeption über die technische Umsetzung bis zum Rollout
Als Business Partner:in für den Bereich Operative Logistik strukturierst, analysierst und visualisierst du komplexe Logistikdaten und schaffst so belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die strategische und operative Steuerung der mehr als 30 Logistikstandorte
Du übernimmst das Stakeholder-Management auf Senior-Management-Ebene und bist gleichzeitig operativer Sparringspartner für die Standorte vor Ort als Brücke zwischen Daten und operativer Realität
Du bewertest die Wirkung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und stellst sicher, dass Verbesserungen nachhaltig im Tagesgeschäft verankert werden
Du verantwortest die Qualität, Konsistenz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Reporting-Strukturen und sorgst für Transparenz in allen relevanten KPIs
Du treibst den Aufbau neuer Dashboards, Automatisierungen und Reporting-Logiken voran und unterstützt Teams dabei, datengetrieben zu arbeiten




Das hast du im Sortiment:

Im Data-Analytics-Umfeld hast du bereits mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung erworben, idealerweise in Logistik oder Operations
Typischerweise hast du ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Logistik oder Data Science erfolgreich abgeschlossen
Du hast bereits eigenständig unternehmensweite Steuerungsinstrumente konzipiert und umgesetzt, die von Führungskräften für operative und strategische Entscheidungen genutzt werden
Du bist stark und hoch effektiv in SQL, Power BI und Low-Code-Tools. Du hebst dich durch gute Kenntnisse in Databricks, Cloud-Technologien und Python hervor und nutzt KI-Tools gezielt dort, wo sie deine Arbeit wirklich voranbringen
Du kannst komplexe Analysen klar und verständlich kommunizieren – ob im Dashboard oder im Gespräch mit Stakeholdern
Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Daten und Prozessen schnell, entwickelst eigenverantwortlich und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch praxisnahe Lösungen und setzt damit messbare Impulse für die Zukunft der flaschenpost
Du sprichst gut Deutsch und bringst idealerweise gute Englischkenntnisse mit




Die Top-Angebote der flaschenpost:

Work-Life-Balance – Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag flexibel und genieße die Freiheit des mobilen Arbeitens
Job-Ticket & Business-Bike – Damit nicht nur deine Arbeitszeit, sondern auch dein Arbeitsweg flexibel bleibt
Start-up-Features – Freigetränke, Kicker und Tischtennis sorgen für den nötigen Ausgleich
flaschenpost Learning – Stelle deine persönliche Learning Journey zusammen und erweitere dein Know-how durch vielfältige und innovative Trainings
Buddy-Programm – Dein flaschenpost-Buddy steht dir während der Einarbeitung mit Rat und Tat zur Seite
Modernste Technik – Wir legen großen Wert auf Fortschritt und Innovation
Team- und Networking-Events – Halte dich fit und lerne deine Kolleg:innen beim Betriebssport, Spieleabend oder Stammtisch besser kennen
Corporate Benefits – Egal ob Shopping oder Sport – Profitiere von Rabatten und Angeboten in Online-Shops, Fitnessstudios sowie exklusiven Konditionen bei Hansefit und Urban Sports Club
Social Responsibility – Blutspenden während der Arbeitszeit und damit Leben retten

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.




Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.




Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.




Principali responsabilità:

Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.




Competenze e capacità richieste:

Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al "cosa", vuoi capire il "perché".
Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.




Requisiti:

Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.




Cosa offriamo:

Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
Pacchetto welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.




Perché lavorare con noi:

Entrerai in un gruppo che integra consulenza, tecnologia e comunicazione, lavorando su progetti concreti per imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione.
Avrai l’opportunità di confrontarti con competenze diverse e contribuire a iniziative che uniscono strategia, execution e sviluppo del mercato.
Lavorerai in un contesto in evoluzione, dove sperimentazione e collaborazione sono parte integrante del modo di operare.
Utilizziamo l’AI e strumenti avanzati per supportare le attività quotidiane e migliorare l’efficacia del lavoro.
Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente che favorisce autonomia e responsabilità.

Polyvalent.e, vous travaillerez sur des problématiques d'analyse de données, de traitements d'informations pour l'ensemble des directions métiers

Capacité à faire des analyses, des synthèses à valeur ajoutée pour le métier,

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Title: Senior BI Data Analyst
Description:
I’m Donatas Šeputis, and I’m looking for a curious, experienced data professional to join us in shaping the future of data and analytics at City Service SE group.

We're building a new, modern data platform — scalable, seamlessly integrated across systems, and designed to turn data into a self-service, 'speak to your data' experience.

We're looking for a Senior BI Data Analyst to turn well-governed data into clear insight and decision-ready reporting across the business. You'll work across a modern data stack — including Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Power BI, Apache Airflow, and GIT — with AI-assisted development support via Claude, partnering closely with our data engineering team to shape what gets modeled, reported, and delivered to the business.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions on top of our MS SQL and Snowflake environments.
Translate business questions into data models, metrics, and visualizations that are accurate, intuitive, and reusable.
Partner with data engineers to define requirements for the semantic/analytics layer, ensuring datasets are structured for reliable reporting.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries for analysis, validation, and ad hoc business questions.
Define and maintain key business metrics, KPI definitions, and a single source of truth across reporting tools (Power BI).
Ensure data quality, consistency, and traceability in reports through validation checks and reconciliation with source systems.
Maintain version-controlled reporting logic and documentation using Git, following review best practices.
Collaborate with business and IT teams, gathering requirements and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data security, access management, and GDPR-aligned governance practices in reporting and dashboards.
Prepare optimized, reliable datasets and visualizations for analytics, reporting, and AI-driven analytical solutions.
Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and dashboard development.
Participate in technical design reviews and propose improvements to reporting architecture and data visualization standards.
Mentor and support the technical growth of junior/mid-level analysts.


What We Expect from You:


A university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or analytics engineering.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience in (complex queries, performance-aware query writing).
Experience with cloud data warehousing, ideally Snowflake.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, and how they feed downstream reporting.
Proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development.
Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language for data analysis and automation is a plus.
Understanding of data warehouse and analytics architecture, including layered ("medallion"-style) data processing approaches.
Experience ensuring data quality, accuracy, and reliability across test and production reporting environments.
Comfort working with AI-assisted tools (e.g. Claude) as part of the analytics workflow.
Ability to collaborate across teams, communicating insights clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Independence, sense of ownership, and initiative in identifying and proposing analytical improvements.
Experience mentoring or supporting less experienced analysts is a plus.


Why Us?


Professional growth and development opportunities within an international group of companies.
Real influence on how the business understands its data — not just building reports, but shaping the metrics and platform behind them.
Help shape a platform where business users can simply ask their data questions — not just build dashboards but build the experience of querying data in plain language.
24/7 accident insurance in Lithuania and abroad.
Hybrid working possibility.


Salary

€3,800–5,400 gross/month

Title: Distributed Cloud | Data Analyst
Description:
At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €1B. We believe in transforming technology to create value for our clients, partners and employees in a world where technology is developed for people. We are proud of the culture we have built together. We are proud of our people at the service of technology. We are proud of our diverse environment. Because we are #TechforPeople. Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries. Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description

We are looking for a sharp and insightful Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence (BI) team. You will be the crucial link between raw data and strategic decisions, responsible for gathering business requirements, transforming complex data, and creating compelling visualizations that drive action across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and translate business needs into technical requirements for data models and reporting solutions.
Develop, optimize, and execute SQL queries to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Design and build dynamic dashboards and reports, primarily using Power BI, to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable business insights.
Perform root-cause analysis on data discrepancies and collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure data quality and availability.
Present findings and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, clearly communicating complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Participate in the full lifecycle of BI projects, from requirements gathering to final deployment.



Qualifications


3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar role focused on data and reporting.
Strong mandatory proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.
Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, data manipulation, automation, and scripting (e.g., using Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries).
Expert hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI (or similar BI tools) for data modeling, visualization, and publishing reports.
Proven ability to gather, document, and manage business requirements effectively.
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with data.
Experience with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling is expected.



Valued Skills:


Experience with other components of the Microsoft Data Stack (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Analysis Services).
Knowledge of Data Modeling principles (e.g., Dimensional Modeling).
Professional fluency (B2+) in French is highly valued and may be a mandatory requirement for allocation on specific projects with Francophone clients.



Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

Title: Data analyst H/F/NB
Description:
Pourquoi rejoindre Keyrus aujourd'hui ?

Keyrus est un groupe international de 2 800 consultants et experts présents dans 28 pays, porté par une conviction forte : ce n'est pas l'intelligence artificielle qui transforme les entreprises, mais l'intelligence conçue, structurée et intégrée à leur fonctionnement.

Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous construisons les fondations data qui permettent aux systèmes intelligents de créer de la valeur. Nous concevons le système d'exploitation de l'entreprise intelligente, où la donnée, l'IA et l'expertise humaine s'intègrent au cœur des processus métiers pour générer une performance durable. Chez Keyrus, nous donnons vie à l'intelligence opérationnelle.

L'intelligence artificielle ne remplace pas l'humain. Elle lui permet de se concentrer sur ce qu'aucun système ne peut reproduire : comprendre, décider, concevoir et innover. Rejoindre Keyrus, c'est construire son jugement, son expertise et sa capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes.

La technologie est un accélérateur. La culture Keyrus fait la différence. L'excellence opérationnelle permet de relier les deux.

Data Analyst

Le Data Analyst fait le lien entre la donnée, les enjeux métiers et la prise de décision. Il transforme des données complexes en analyses claires, fiables et directement exploitables pour aider les organisations à mieux comprendre leur activité, mesurer leur performance et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.

Chez Keyrus, le Data Analyst ne se limite pas à produire des reportings : il cherche à comprendre les problématiques derrière les données, challenge les besoins et contribue à transformer l’information en actions concrètes et créatrices de valeur.

Ce qui vous attend


Analyser des données complexes afin de produire des indicateurs fiables et exploitables par les équipes métier.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord interactifs répondant aux besoins opérationnels et stratégiques.
Préparer, transformer et modéliser les données afin de garantir leur qualité, leur cohérence et leur exploitabilité.
Accompagner les métiers dans la définition de leurs besoins analytiques et les conseiller sur les indicateurs les plus pertinents.
Traduire les analyses en recommandations concrètes et adaptées aux enjeux des utilisateurs.
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des reportings existants en recherchant performance, simplicité et valeur métier.
Automatiser les traitements de données lorsque cela est pertinent afin de fiabiliser et d’optimiser les analyses.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data Engineering, AI Engineering et les métiers afin de garantir la disponibilité, la qualité et la bonne compréhension de la donnée.
Participer à la diffusion d’une culture Data et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’appropriation des outils et des analyses.
Identifier de nouveaux usages de la donnée et proposer des pistes d’amélioration en fonction des besoins métier et des évolutions technologiques.


Ce que vous apportez

Chez Keyrus, nous recherchons des profils capables de conjuguer expertise Data, compréhension métier et capacité à transformer les analyses en actions concrètes.

Notre approche Architect of Intelligence repose sur une conviction : la donnée prend toute sa valeur lorsqu’elle est comprise, partagée et mise au service de décisions et de transformations concrètes.

Dans Ce Rôle, Nous Valorisons Notamment

Expérience et parcours


Une expérience significative en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence ou Data Visualisation.
Une expérience dans la conception de tableaux de bord et d’indicateurs décisionnels.
Une expérience de collaboration avec les équipes métier afin de transformer un besoin fonctionnel en solution analytique.
Une expérience dans des environnements Data modernes constitue un véritable atout.


Posture et savoir-être


Une forte capacité d’analyse permettant de transformer des données complexes en recommandations concrètes.
De la curiosité pour comprendre les enjeux métiers derrière les données et les indicateurs.
De la créativité et une capacité à explorer de nouvelles approches pour répondre aux problématiques rencontrées.
Une capacité à communiquer, vulgariser et raconter les données auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques.
Une conscience professionnelle et une attention particulière portée à la qualité et à la fiabilité des analyses.
Une autonomie dans la conduite des analyses tout en appréciant le travail collaboratif.
Une capacité à passer de l’analyse à l’action et à formuler des recommandations pragmatiques.
Une volonté de documenter, partager et transmettre les analyses et les bonnes pratiques.


Compétences techniques indispensables


Maîtrise avancée de SQL.
Maîtrise d’au moins un outil de Data Visualisation tel que Power BI, Tableau ou équivalent.
Bonne maîtrise de la modélisation de données décisionnelles.
Expérience des outils de préparation de données : Alteryx, Dataiku, Power Query ou équivalent.
Compréhension des enjeux de qualité, de gouvernance et de fiabilité des données.
Connaissances en Python ou R appréciées pour l’automatisation et l’analyse avancée.
Capacité à concevoir des KPI pertinents et à produire des tableaux de bord orientés décision.
Compréhension des environnements Cloud Data : Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric ou équivalent.
Expérience des méthodes Agile.
Anglais professionnel courant, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, indispensable quel que soit le niveau d’expérience.


Ce qui nous anime

Intelligence Collective

La collaboration entre expertises, métiers et géographies nous permet de combiner les savoir-faire et d'apporter des réponses plus complètes aux défis de nos clients.

Fiabilité

Notre capacité à délivrer des projets complexes avec rigueur et exigence constitue l'un des fondements de la relation de confiance que nous construisons avec nos clients.

Pragmatisme

Nous privilégions l'impact concret et la création de valeur mesurable plutôt que les discours technologiques abstraits.

Esprit Entrepreneurial

La curiosité, l'énergie et l'autonomie sont au cœur de notre culture. Elles favorisent l'initiative, l'innovation et le développement continu de nos expertises.

À propos de Keyrus

Chez Keyrus, nous accompagnons les organisations dans leur passage d'une IA expérimentale à une IA industrialisée, d'agents isolés à des systèmes orchestrés, et de l'analyse à l'exécution. C'est cette expertise que nous appelons l'Architecture de l'Intelligence.

Grâce à notre modèle propriétaire Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), nous concevons des environnements intelligents reposant sur trois piliers fondamentaux : des fondations data et intelligence robustes et fiables ; une gouvernance garantissant que l'humain reste au cœur de la décision ; des mécanismes de pilotage de la performance permettant une amélioration continue.

Fort de plus de 30 ans d'expertise et de 2 800 collaborateurs répartis dans 28 pays, Keyrus accompagne les entreprises bien au-delà de leur transformation.

Keyrus est coté sur Euronext Growth Paris (ALKEY – Code ISIN : FR0004029411).

Title: Analista de Datos BI
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
¿Consideras que tienes una gran capacidad analítica? ¿te apasiona entender el día a día de nuestro negocio? ¡Te estamos buscando!

En Verisure buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos BI para el área de Operational Managament dentro de la Dirección de Operaciones.

La misión de esta posición será el apoyo y seguimiento de los performances operativos de las diferentes áreas de negocio.

Principales Funciones


Realizar análisis exploratorios y explicativos sobre grandes volúmenes de datos, identificando patrones, oportunidades y palancas de mejora para el negocio. Se requiere pensamiento crítico y creativo “out of the box”.
Proporcionar insights a través del análisis que ayuden a la priorización de diferentes proyectos / iniciativas en el negocio.
Colaborar estrechamente con diferentes equipos (Producto, Operaciones, Marketing, Planificación, Financiero) para entender necesidades, traducirlas a soluciones analíticas y asegurar la adopción de resultados
Realizar múltiples reportes automatizados e interactivos que permitan hacer el seguimiento y traccionar principales KPI operativos.
Trabajar con múltiples fuentes de datos (Datos internos- conexiones ODBS, Nube-AWS, Snowflake, ficheros externos), asegurando la calidad, consistencia y correcto modelado de la información.
Detectar desvíos y liderar propuestas para mejorar el servicio.
Tener el governance del dato al construir nuevas métricas, mantener las existentes y detectar posibles incidencias.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Place: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Are you looking for an innovative and established organisation where you can develop your career? Are you passionate about turning data into real impact? This is your chance!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to drive a data-driven culture across our corporate divisions. You will be part of the Data & Advanced Analytics team, helping to transform information into smarter, more strategic decisions.

You will be part of key initiatives in advanced analytics, data governance and artificial intelligence, driving continuous improvement by identifying opportunities and generating actionable insights. This role combines technical challenges with a strong business acumen, involving you in projects that have a real impact on the organisation’s transformation and evolution.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Within our team, your main responsibilities will be:


Analysing corporate data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities for improvement that drive decision-making.
Creating dashboards, reports and key performance indicators using visualisation tools that facilitate business interpretation.
Design and develop data integration and transformation processes (ETL/ELT) to ensure data availability and reliability.
Define and build data models aligned with the organisation’s analytical needs.
Ensure the quality, consistency and traceability of data throughout its entire lifecycle.
Work with economic, financial and operational information, ensuring data consistency and correct reconciliation.
Collaborate closely with the various business areas to understand their needs and translate them into high-value analytical solutions.
Participate in data governance initiatives, contributing to the efficient and structured management of corporate data.
Identify opportunities to incorporate Artificial Intelligence and language models (LLMs) into corporate processes.
Drive initiatives for automation, innovation and continuous improvement within the data ecosystem.
Promote a cross-functional view of processes and data, encouraging collaboration between departments.


WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Previous experience in all the areas described is not essential for this role. We particularly value the ability to learn, intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach and a keen interest in further developing your knowledge of data analytics and artificial intelligence.

We are looking for a professional with analytical skills, critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset. The ability to conceptualise, synthesise and draw conclusions from data, as well as adapt messages to different audiences, and experience in data analysis and exploitation.

Knowledge and experience of the following would be required:


Data visualisation tools (Spotfire, Power BI or similar).
Programming in Python and advanced SQL.
Design and development of ETL processes
Modelling of relational and analytical databases.
Data governance, data quality and metadata management.


The following will be considered an advantage:


Knowledge of applied statistics and quantitative analysis.
Ability to interact with business users and translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and language models (LLMs), as well as their practical applications in business environments.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Dans le cadre de projets de transformation data, nous recherchons un·e Data Analyst capable de transformer les données en informations actionnables pour les équipes métiers et les équipes de pilotage.




Vous interviendrez sur des missions longues, au sein d’environnements structurés, pour analyser, fiabiliser et valoriser les données. Vous contribuerez à la production d’indicateurs, de reportings et de tableaux de bord destinés à accompagner la prise de décision et l’amélioration des parcours, outils et processus internes.




Vos missions




Recueillir, comprendre et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers.
Extraire, nettoyer, contrôler et analyser les données issues de différentes sources.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et reportings décisionnels.
Définir et suivre les KPI nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité.
Produire des analyses ad hoc afin d’identifier des tendances, anomalies, opportunités ou axes d’amélioration.
Participer à la fiabilisation et à la documentation des données et des indicateurs.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, produit et métier.
Restituer les résultats de manière claire, synthétique et adaptée à des interlocuteurs variés.
Contribuer à la diffusion d’une culture data au sein des équipes.




Profil recherché




Formation supérieure en data, statistiques, informatique, école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
Expérience significative en analyse de données, BI ou pilotage de la performance.
Très bonne maîtrise de SQL et des outils de visualisation de données.
Maîtrise de Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense ou d’un outil équivalent.
Connaissance de Python ou R pour l’analyse et la préparation des données.
Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métier et à les traduire en indicateurs pertinents.
Rigueur, esprit analytique, autonomie et excellentes capacités de communication.
Maîtrise du français ; un anglais professionnel est apprécié.




Les plus




Connaissance de Dataiku pour la préparation, l’analyse ou l’industrialisation des traitements data.
Connaissance de Talend ou d’un outil ETL équivalent.
Expérience sur des données complexes et volumineuses.
Expérience auprès de grands comptes de l’assurance, des mutuelles ou de la protection sociale.
Sensibilité aux enjeux de gouvernance, de confidentialité et de conformité des données.




Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.




Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.




Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.




Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.




Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.




Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien ?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

SPAM

Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage.

Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support.

Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales :

Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification;

Korner : incubateur de startups tech;

Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi

l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions.

Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité.

KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès.

Le Poste

Rejoignez un acteur majeur du secteur de la banque et contribuez à des projets à fort impact !

Vous avez envie de rejoindre une ESN moderne, avec un business model participatif, tournée vers l'humain et la formation de ses collaborateurs ?

Alors nous avons besoin de vous pour répondre aux différents besoins de nos clients !

Si vous faites le pari de nous rejoindre, vous évoluerez chez différents clients au fil de votre expérience chez Klanik.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Data d'un de nos clients dans le secteur bancaire , nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst BI pour intervenir auprès d'une ou plusieurs équipes produit .

Vous rejoindrez un environnement Data structuré, au sein duquel vous contribuerez directement à la valorisation des données, à la production d'analyses et de tableaux de bord, ainsi qu'à l'accompagnement des métiers dans leurs problématiques décisionnelles.

Vous évoluerez dans un contexte Agile, en étroite collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts, équipes de développement et interlocuteurs métiers.

L'environnement technique s'articule notamment autour de SQL, MicroStrategy et Teradata.

Vos principales missions

En tant que Data Analyst BI, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :


Collaborer avec les Business Analysts afin de comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) pertinents.
Explorer, analyser et valoriser les données disponibles afin de produire des analyses descriptives, reporting et tableaux de bord BI.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord MicroStrategy, en veillant à leur pertinence fonctionnelle et à leur qualité.
Requêter et extraire les données via des scripts SQL, à des fins d'analyse ou pour répondre à des besoins opérationnels.
Conduire des analyses Data en lien direct avec les problématiques et enjeux métiers.
Présenter les résultats des analyses auprès d'un public métier varié, animer des réunions et faciliter la compréhension des données.
Interpréter les résultats et formuler des insights et recommandations business auprès des parties prenantes.
Accompagner les métiers dans l'application des principes de gouvernance et de protection de la donnée : Data Management, Data Privacy, conformité, etc.
Documenter les analyses, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques ainsi que les guides utilisateurs des tableaux de bord.
Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des livrables existants : évolution des rapports, optimisation des dashboards et amélioration des processus analytiques.
Être force de proposition sur les solutions permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la pertinence et l'efficacité des analyses BI.

Chez Klanik, nous souhaitons apporter la meilleure expérience candidat possible. Ainsi, nous privilégions les processus de recrutements les plus courts possibles, et encadrés par des valeurs de partage, de bienveillance et d'exigence.

Vous serez amené à échanger tout au long du processus avec :


Nos HR Partner
Nos Validateurs Techniques
Nos Business Managers

Formation et expérience


Formation supérieure Bac +3 minimum en informatique ou domaine équivalent.
5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste équivalent
Expérience significative dans le secteur bancaire


Compétences techniques indispensables


Maîtrise des requêtes et de l'extraction de données pour les besoins d'analyse
Expertise indispensable en SQL.
Maîtrise des environnements de bases de données SQL
Expertise sur un outil de Data Visualisation / Business Intelligence
Une expertise sur Power BI ou Tableau peut également être considérée


Qualités attendues


Excellente communication & pédagogie
Esprit d'équipe

Autonomie & adaptabilité

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Banque mutualiste et régionale, La Caisse d'Epargne CEPAC est aujourd’hui l’une des premières banques de l’arc méditerranéen et de l’outre-mer.

Nous bénéficions d'un maillage territorial exceptionnel à travers nos 241 agences, tout en participant au financement et développement de l'économie locale.

L'ambition de la Caisse d'Epargne CEPAC est d'offrir à ses 1,4 million de clients le meilleur de la relation humaine, digitale, dans un esprit collaboratif, grâce à ses 3150 collaborateurs.

Pour accompagner son développement dans la dimension client et sa performance commerciale, la Caisse d’Epargne CEPAC recrute un Data Analyst (H/F) au sein de la Direction Data, Communication et CRM.

Poste et missions

Au sein du Département Data, vos principales missions seront de :


Participer à l’identification et à la qualification des besoins en relation avec différents acteurs internes et externes
Réaliser des études orientées client et proposer des plans d’action en lien avec la stratégie commerciale de la CEPAC
Contrôler, analyser et challenger la fiabilité des données de la CEPAC dans une logique d’amélioration de la connaissance client et d’optimisation de nos processus de fonctionnement
Développer, maintenir et optimiser les différents outils de datavisualisation proposés par le département à ses interlocuteurs internes et externes

Compétences techniques:


Maîtrise du langage SQL
Connaissance d’un outil de datavisualisation de type Power BI


Qualités requises :


Capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de restitution à des profils techniques et non-techniques
Aisance relationnelle et esprit d’équipe
Force de proposition
Capacité à mener plusieurs projets de front


Formation :


Formation supérieure type école d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé dans l’analyse de données (informatique, statistiques)
Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans sur un poste similaire (analyse de données, études clients et mise en œuvre de plans d'actions)


Expérience requise :


Une première expérience dans le milieu bancaire est un plus

Possibilité de travail selon les accords d'entreprise (2 jours par semaine après 6 mois d'ancienneté)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to join a growing team of top professionals who invest time and effort into teaching, career growth, and cultivating employees into the next generation of IT experts? You've come to the right place. Span is an international IT company with over 30 years of experience in developing and delivering advanced technology solutions. Span is recognized in the market as a multi-specialist with a business focus on three key strategic areas: cloud, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. We're constantly improving, advancing, and adopting new trends, new skills, and new expertise, giving our employees virtually endless opportunities for professional development.




The Software & AI Solutions business unit gathers over 140 experts and is one of Span's key pillars. We focus on developing advanced software solutions, applying artificial intelligence, and processing and analyzing data to create real business value for our clients. We work across various industries and deliver solutions that make a tangible difference, both for our external clients and our internal needs.




We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong analytical background, experience with data analysis tools, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. This role requires a proactive individual with excellent problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail.




What you'll do:

Design and build high-performance, scalable end-to-end analytical solutions – from understanding business needs and modelling data to delivering intuitive reports and dashboards
Develop, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reports that support strategic and operational decision-making
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand complex requirements, challenge assumptions, and translate them into scalable data solutions
Perform ad hoc analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and insights that support business decisions
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability by applying analytical best practices throughout the reporting lifecycle
Contribute to improving our BI solutions and reporting processes by proposing new approaches, optimizing existing solutions, and promoting BI best practices
Support business users through workshops, training sessions, and presentations




We could be a perfect fit if you are:

Approaching activities in a planned and organized manner, focused on essentials and working quickly and efficiently
Showing a strong desire for constant career development and gaining experience
Inclined to innovate, always trying out different approaches and looking for new, better and more efficient ways of working
Appreciating and accepting differences, respecting other people and their opinions and ideas and readily giving them yourself




What we expect:

BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics or similar data-focused roles
Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
Experience with BI tools, preferably Power BI
Understanding of data modelling principles and experience designing semantic models for analytical reporting
Experience designing and developing reports and dashboards following data visualization best practices
Experience working with large and complex datasets, including query and reporting performance optimization
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
Good spoken and written English skills
Attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality
