Title: Data Analyst maîtrisant
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Notre entreprise accompagne plusieurs clients dans la structuration, l’analyse et la valorisation de leurs données. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst pour intervenir auprès de différentes organisations sur des enjeux de reporting, data visualisation et modélisation BI.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe data avec pour objectif de collecter, explorer et interpréter les données, puis de mettre à disposition des reportings clairs et utiles pour les équipes produits et métiers.

Vos missions


Accompagner les équipes produits dans l’analyse de leurs données
Concevoir des dashboards et reports lisibles pour le suivi des KPI
Produire des analyses ponctuelles sous forme de présentations ou notes de synthèse
Participer à la modélisation BI et à la conception des flux de données
Définir des bonnes pratiques et guidelines pour fiabiliser la production des indicateurs et tableaux de bord


Profil recherché


Formation : Bac+4/5 en data, statistiques, BI, informatique ou équivalent
Expérience : 4 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que data analyst
Compétences obligatoires :
SQL confirmé
Expérience en analyse de données
Bon niveau sur la conception de reporting et KPI
Compétences importantes :
Outil de data visualisation type Power BI, Looker ou équivalent
Modélisation BI confirmée
Qualités personnelles :
Esprit d’analyse
Rigueur
Capacité à travailler avec des données imparfaites
Bon relationnel
Capacité d’adaptation à différents environnements clients
Langues : anglais courant


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier entretien avec un(e) Digital Sales Manager pour se découvrir mutuellement
Un second entretien avec un(e) associé(e) co-fondateur.rice pour aller plus loin dans les problématiques abordées en mission et les enjeux maîtrisés
Un dernier entretien avec un(e) Consultant(e) Senior, pour faire le point sur votre positionnement et vos compétences


Nous sommes agiles ! Ces entretiens peuvent se faire en visio et/ou en présentiel, dans cet ordre ou un autre.

Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Place: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Are you looking for an innovative and established organisation where you can develop your career? Are you passionate about turning data into real impact? This is your chance!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to drive a data-driven culture across our corporate divisions. You will be part of the Data & Advanced Analytics team, helping to transform information into smarter, more strategic decisions.

You will be part of key initiatives in advanced analytics, data governance and artificial intelligence, driving continuous improvement by identifying opportunities and generating actionable insights. This role combines technical challenges with a strong business acumen, involving you in projects that have a real impact on the organisation’s transformation and evolution.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Within our team, your main responsibilities will be:


Analysing corporate data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities for improvement that drive decision-making.
Creating dashboards, reports and key performance indicators using visualisation tools that facilitate business interpretation.
Design and develop data integration and transformation processes (ETL/ELT) to ensure data availability and reliability.
Define and build data models aligned with the organisation’s analytical needs.
Ensure the quality, consistency and traceability of data throughout its entire lifecycle.
Work with economic, financial and operational information, ensuring data consistency and correct reconciliation.
Collaborate closely with the various business areas to understand their needs and translate them into high-value analytical solutions.
Participate in data governance initiatives, contributing to the efficient and structured management of corporate data.
Identify opportunities to incorporate Artificial Intelligence and language models (LLMs) into corporate processes.
Drive initiatives for automation, innovation and continuous improvement within the data ecosystem.
Promote a cross-functional view of processes and data, encouraging collaboration between departments.


WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Previous experience in all the areas described is not essential for this role. We particularly value the ability to learn, intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach and a keen interest in further developing your knowledge of data analytics and artificial intelligence.

We are looking for a professional with analytical skills, critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset. The ability to conceptualise, synthesise and draw conclusions from data, as well as adapt messages to different audiences, and experience in data analysis and exploitation.

Knowledge and experience of the following would be required:


Data visualisation tools (Spotfire, Power BI or similar).
Programming in Python and advanced SQL.
Design and development of ETL processes
Modelling of relational and analytical databases.
Data governance, data quality and metadata management.


The following will be considered an advantage:


Knowledge of applied statistics and quantitative analysis.
Ability to interact with business users and translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and language models (LLMs), as well as their practical applications in business environments.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

Title: Statistician/Data Analyst
Description:
Job Specification

Statistician / Data Analyst – Microsoft Fabric

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Statistician / Data Analyst with strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Power BI/Tableau, Azure Data Factory, Python and R.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing complex datasets, developing advanced reporting and visualisations, supporting data ingestion and transformation, and delivering high-quality analytical solutions aligned with business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Apply advanced technical data analysis techniques to extract, manipulate, cleanse and analyse complex datasets.
Write and optimise complex SQL queries, including the development of complex stored procedures.
Work with Microsoft Fabric to support modern data analytics, reporting and data engineering requirements.
Develop advanced data visualisations and dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
Produce business and technical reports using reporting tools such as SSRS.
Apply descriptive and predictive analytics to support business decision-making.
Use Python and/or R for statistical analysis, data modelling and analytical projects.
Design and implement data ingestion pipelines using Azure Data Factory, including data transformations into Azure SQL environments.
Work with large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns and actionable insights.
Prepare clear and comprehensive technical support documentation, explaining the approach taken for specific work items, reports and analytical solutions.
Conduct walkthroughs of completed work with team members and relevant stakeholders.
Manage multiple business priorities and work requests simultaneously, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.
Work closely with business and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business needs.

Essential Skills & Experience

Strong practical experience in data analysis / statistics within a technical environment.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric.
Advanced SQL skills, including:
Complex query writing
Data extraction and manipulation
Data cleansing
Query optimisation
Complex stored procedures
Strong practical experience with Power BI or Tableau and advanced data visualisation.
Experience with SSRS or similar reporting tools.
Project-based experience applying descriptive and predictive analytics.
Strong programming experience in Python and/or R.
Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for data ingestion and transformation.
Experience working with Azure SQL.
Excellent documentation and technical communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into practical data solutions.

Desirable Experience

Broader experience across the Microsoft Azure data and analytics ecosystem.
Experience working with modern cloud-based data platforms and data warehousing.
Experience working with large-scale datasets and complex data environments.
Experience collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Competencies

Job Specification

Statistician / Data Analyst – Microsoft Fabric

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Statistician / Data Analyst with strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Power BI/Tableau, Azure Data Factory, Python and R.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing complex datasets, developing advanced reporting and visualisations, supporting data ingestion and transformation, and delivering high-quality analytical solutions aligned with business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced technical data analysis techniques to extract, manipulate, cleanse and analyse complex datasets.
  • Write and optimise complex SQL queries, including the development of complex stored procedures.
  • Work with Microsoft Fabric to support modern data analytics, reporting and data engineering requirements.
  • Develop advanced data visualisations and dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
  • Produce business and technical reports using reporting tools such as SSRS.
  • Apply descriptive and predictive analytics to support business decision-making.
  • Use Python and/or R for statistical analysis, data modelling and analytical projects.
  • Design and implement data ingestion pipelines using Azure Data Factory, including data transformations into Azure SQL environments.
  • Work with large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns and actionable insights.
  • Prepare clear and comprehensive technical support documentation, explaining the approach taken for specific work items, reports and analytical solutions.
  • Conduct walkthroughs of completed work with team members and relevant stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple business priorities and work requests simultaneously, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.
  • Work closely with business and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business needs.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong practical experience in data analysis / statistics within a technical environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including:
  • Complex query writing
  • Data extraction and manipulation
  • Data cleansing
  • Query optimisation
  • Complex stored procedures
  • Strong practical experience with Power BI or Tableau and advanced data visualisation.
  • Experience with SSRS or similar reporting tools.
  • Project-based experience applying descriptive and predictive analytics.
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or R.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Experience working with Azure SQL.
  • Excellent documentation and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into practical data solutions.

Desirable Experience

  • Broader experience across the Microsoft Azure data and analytics ecosystem.
  • Experience working with modern cloud-based data platforms and data warehousing.
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and complex data environments.
  • Experience collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Competencies

  • Advanced analytical and statistical thinking
  • Strong SQL and data manipulation skills
  • Data visualisation and reporting
  • Predictive and descriptive analytics
  • Cloud data engineering
  • Technical documentation
  • Problem solving
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Organisation and prioritisation
  • Quality-focused delivery

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst - Commercial




Location: Dublin with 2 days per week in the office




We are working with one of Ireland's leading financial services organisations as they look to hire a Senior Data Analyst to join their growing transformation and analytics function.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced analyst who enjoys partnering with senior commercial stakeholders, turning complex data into actionable insights, and influencing business decisions that drive growth.

The successful candidate will take ownership of supporting sales, marketing & customer stakeholders to identify opportunities, improve performance, and support key business initiatives.




In this role you will:

Build and own a suite of commercial analytics and reporting solutions that support business strategy and decision-making.
Create actionable insights with the right data around customer analytics, next best offers, lead funnel/customer lifecycle, trend visualisation, etc.).
Working with multiple data sources to understand data flows to improve data quality and reporting.
Partnering with senior leaders and key stakeholders across the business to understand challenges and develop data-driven solutions.
Driving automation and reporting improvements, reducing manual processes and increasing business efficiency and data quality.




You will have:

7+ years’ experience in Data Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar role.
Strong hands-on experience building Power BI dashboards end-to-end. Advanced Power Query and DAX skills, including complex transformations and custom measures.
Strong SQL skills with experience working across multiple data sources with ETL capabilities.
Proven ability to translate business questions into effective data and reporting solutions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and non-technical business users.
Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.




Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where data is becoming a key driver of business performance. You will have a direct impact on commercial outcomes for the business and will work within a great team with an excellent hiring manager.
